fields.name: account
fields.description: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

fields.name: advid
fields.description: Unique identifier of advertisement message.

fields.name: advrefid
fields.description: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE transaction types.

fields.name: advside
fields.description: Broker's side of advertised trade

fields.name: advtranstype
fields.description: Identifies advertisement message transaction type

fields.name: avgpx
fields.description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

fields.name: beginseqno
fields.description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent

fields.name: beginstring
fields.description: Identifies beginning of new message and session protocol version by means of a session profile identifier (see FIX Session Layer for details). ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted).

fields.name: bodylength
fields.description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: Three byte, simple checksum (see Volume 2: "Checksum Calculation" for description). ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e. serves, with the trailing <SOH>, as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: clordid
fields.description: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the buy-side (institution, broker, intermediary etc.) (identified by SenderCompID(49) or OnBehalfOfCompID(115) as appropriate). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms, particularly those which electronically submit multi-day orders, trade globally or throughout market close periods, should ensure uniqueness across days, for example by embedding a date within the ClOrdID(11) field.

fields.name: commission
fields.description: Commission. Note if CommType (13) is percentage, Commission of 5% should be represented as .05.

fields.name: commtype
fields.description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the total commission based on the rate.

fields.name: cumqty
fields.description: Total quantity (e.g. number of shares) filled.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Identifies currency used for price or quantity fields, depending on the asset class being traded. CurrencyCodeSource(2897) may be used to disambiguate the code source scheme used, and ISO 4217 is the default scheme if absent.

fields.name: endseqno
fields.description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent. If request is for a single message BeginSeqNo (7) = EndSeqNo. If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo = "0" (representing infinity).

fields.name: execid
fields.description: Unique identifier of execution message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN) (will be 0 (zero) for ExecType (150)=I (Order Status)).

fields.name: execinst
fields.description: Instructions for order handling on exchange trading floor. If more than one instruction is applicable to an order, this field can contain multiple instructions separated by space. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

fields.name: execrefid
fields.description: Reference identifier used with Trade, Trade Cancel and Trade Correct execution types.

fields.name: handlinst
fields.description: Instructions for order handling on Broker trading floor

fields.name: securityidsource
fields.description: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID(48) value.

fields.name: ioiid
fields.description: Unique identifier of IOI message.

fields.name: ioiqltyind
fields.description: Relative quality of indication

fields.name: ioirefid
fields.description: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE, transaction types.

fields.name: ioiqty
fields.description: Quantity (e.g. number of shares) in numeric form or relative size.

fields.name: ioitranstype
fields.description: Identifies IOI message transaction type

fields.name: lastcapacity
fields.description: Broker capacity in order execution

fields.name: lastmkt
fields.description: Market of execution for last fill, or an indication of the market where an order was routed

fields.name: lastpx
fields.description: Price of this (last) fill.

fields.name: lastqty
fields.description: Quantity (e.g. shares) bought/sold on this (last) fill.

fields.name: nolinesoftext
fields.description: Identifies number of lines of text body

fields.name: msgseqnum
fields.description: Integer message sequence number.

fields.name: msgtype
fields.description: Defines message type ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: newseqno
fields.description: New sequence number

fields.name: orderid
fields.description: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which accept multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the OrderID field to assure uniqueness across days.

fields.name: orderqty
fields.description: Quantity ordered. This represents the number of shares for equities or par, face or nominal value for FI instruments.

fields.name: ordstatus
fields.description: Identifies current status of order. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

fields.name: ordtype
fields.description: Order type.

fields.name: origclordid
fields.description: ClOrdID (11) of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) as assigned by the institution, used to identify the previous order in cancel and cancel/replace requests.

fields.name: origtime
fields.description: Time of message origination (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT"))

fields.name: possdupflag
fields.description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

fields.name: price
fields.description: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

fields.name: refseqnum
fields.description: Reference message sequence number

fields.name: securityid
fields.description: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource (22) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityIDSource.

fields.name: sendercompid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

fields.name: sendersubid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

fields.name: sendingtime
fields.description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Overall/total quantity (e.g. number of shares)

fields.name: side
fields.description: Side of order (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Ticker symbol. Common, "human understood" representation of the security. SecurityID (48) value can be specified if no symbol exists (e.g. non-exchange traded Collective Investment Vehicles)

fields.name: targetcompid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify receiving firm.

fields.name: targetsubid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Free format text string

fields.name: timeinforce
fields.description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Absence of this field is interpreted as DAY. NOTE not applicable to CIV Orders.

fields.name: transacttime
fields.description: Timestamp when the business transaction represented by the message occurred.

fields.name: urgency
fields.description: Urgency flag

fields.name: validuntiltime
fields.description: Indicates expiration time of indication message (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

fields.name: settltype
fields.description: Indicates order settlement period. If present, SettlDate (64) overrides this field. If both SettlType (63) and SettDate (64) are omitted, the default for SettlType (63) is 0 (Regular)

fields.name: settldate
fields.description: Specific date of trade settlement (SettlementDate) in YYYYMMDD format.

fields.name: symbolsfx
fields.description: Additional information about the security (e.g. preferred, warrants, etc.). Note also see SecurityType (167).

fields.name: listid
fields.description: Unique identifier for list as assigned by institution, used to associate multiple individual orders. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which generate multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the ListID field to assure uniqueness across days.

fields.name: listseqno
fields.description: Sequence of individual order within list (i.e. ListSeqNo of TotNoOrders (68), 2 of 25, 3 of 25, . . . )

fields.name: totnoorders
fields.description: Total number of list order entries across all messages. Should be the sum of all NoOrders (73) in each message that has repeating list order entries related to the same ListID (66). Used to support fragmentation.

fields.name: listexecinst
fields.description: Free format text message containing list handling and execution instructions.

fields.name: allocid
fields.description: Unique identifier for allocation message.

fields.name: alloctranstype
fields.description: Identifies allocation transaction type *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" ***

fields.name: refallocid
fields.description: Reference identifier to be used with AllocTransType (71) = Replace or Cancel.

fields.name: noorders
fields.description: Indicates number of orders to be combined for average pricing and allocation.

fields.name: avgpxprecision
fields.description: Indicates number of decimal places to be used for average pricing. Absence of this field indicates that default precision arranged by the broker/institution is to be used.

fields.name: tradedate
fields.description: Indicates date of trading day. Absence of this field indicates current day (expressed in local time at place of trade).

fields.name: positioneffect
fields.description: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together.

fields.name: noallocs
fields.description: Number of repeating AllocAccount (79)/AllocPrice (366) entries.

fields.name: allocaccount
fields.description: Sub-account mnemonic

fields.name: allocqty
fields.description: Quantity to be allocated to specific sub-account

fields.name: processcode
fields.description: Processing code for sub-account. Absence of this field in AllocAccount (79) / AllocPrice (366) /AllocQty (80) / ProcessCode instance indicates regular trade.

fields.name: norpts
fields.description: Total number of reports within series.

fields.name: rptseq
fields.description: Sequence number of message within report series. Used to carry reporting sequence number of the fill as represented on the Trade Report Side.

fields.name: cxlqty
fields.description: Total quantity canceled for this order.

fields.name: nodlvyinst
fields.description: Number of delivery instruction fields in repeating group.

fields.name: allocstatus
fields.description: Identifies status of allocation.

fields.name: allocrejcode
fields.description: Identifies reason for rejection.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Electronic signature

fields.name: securedatalen
fields.description: Length of encrypted message

fields.name: securedata
fields.description: Actual encrypted data stream

fields.name: signaturelength
fields.description: Number of bytes in signature field

fields.name: emailtype
fields.description: Email message type.

fields.name: rawdatalength
fields.description: Number of bytes in raw data field.

fields.name: rawdata
fields.description: Unformatted raw data, can include bitmaps, word processor documents, etc.

fields.name: possresend
fields.description: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

fields.name: encryptmethod
fields.description: Method of encryption.

fields.name: stoppx
fields.description: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

fields.name: exdestination
fields.description: Execution destination as defined by institution when order is entered.

fields.name: cxlrejreason
fields.description: Code to identify reason for rejection of cancellation or modification.

fields.name: ordrejreason
fields.description: Code to identify reason for order rejection. Note: Values 3, 4, and 5 will be used when rejecting an order due to pre-allocation information errors.

fields.name: ioiqualifier
fields.description: Code to qualify IOI use. (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

fields.name: issuer
fields.description: Name of security issuer (e.g. International Business Machines, GNMA).

fields.name: securitydesc
fields.description: Can be used by the venue or one of the trading parties to provide a non-normative textual description for the financial instrument.

fields.name: heartbtint
fields.description: Heartbeat interval (seconds)

fields.name: minqty
fields.description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed.

fields.name: maxfloor
fields.description: The quantity to be displayed . Required for reserve orders. On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

fields.name: testreqid
fields.description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat

fields.name: reporttoexch
fields.description: Identifies party of trade responsible for exchange reporting.

fields.name: locatereqd
fields.description: Indicates whether the broker is to locate the stock in conjunction with a short sell order.

fields.name: onbehalfofcompid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID field and the firm originating the message in this field.

fields.name: onbehalfofsubid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: quoteid
fields.description: Unique identifier for quote

fields.name: netmoney
fields.description: Total amount due as the result of the transaction (e.g. for Buy order - principal + commission + fees) reported in currency of execution.

fields.name: settlcurramt
fields.description: Total amount due expressed in settlement currency (includes the effect of the forex transaction)

fields.name: settlcurrency
fields.description: Currency code of settlement denomination.

fields.name: forexreq
fields.description: Indicates request for forex accommodation trade to be executed along with security transaction.

fields.name: origsendingtime
fields.description: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT") when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

fields.name: gapfillflag
fields.description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

fields.name: noexecs
fields.description: Number of executions or trades.

fields.name: expiretime
fields.description: Time/Date of order expiration (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

fields.name: dkreason
fields.description: Reason for execution rejection.

fields.name: delivertocompid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID (56) field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

fields.name: delivertosubid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

fields.name: ioinaturalflag
fields.description: Indicates that IOI is the result of an existing agency order or a facilitation position resulting from an agency order, not from principal trading or order solicitation activity.

fields.name: quotereqid
fields.description: Unique identifier for a QuoteRequest(35=R).

fields.name: bidpx
fields.description: Bid price/rate

fields.name: offerpx
fields.description: Offer price/rate

fields.name: bidsize
fields.description: Quantity of bid

fields.name: offersize
fields.description: Quantity of offer

fields.name: nomiscfees
fields.description: Number of repeating groups of miscellaneous fees

fields.name: miscfeeamt
fields.description: Miscellaneous fee value

fields.name: miscfeecurr
fields.description: Currency of miscellaneous fee

fields.name: miscfeetype
fields.description: Indicates type of miscellaneous fee.

fields.name: prevclosepx
fields.description: Previous closing price of security.

fields.name: resetseqnumflag
fields.description: Indicates that both sides of the FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

fields.name: senderlocationid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

fields.name: targetlocationid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message destination's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

fields.name: onbehalfoflocationid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: delivertolocationid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: norelatedsym
fields.description: Specifies the number of repeating symbols specified.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject of an Email message

fields.name: headline
fields.description: The headline of a News message

fields.name: urllink
fields.description: A URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) or URL (Uniform Resource Locator) link to additional information (i.e. http://www.XYZ.com/research.html)

fields.name: exectype
fields.description: Describes the specific ExecutionRpt (e.g. Pending Cancel) while OrdStatus(39) will always identify the current order status (e.g. Partially Filled).

fields.name: leavesqty
fields.description: Quantity open for further execution. If the OrdStatus (39) is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty (38) - CumQty (14).

fields.name: cashorderqty
fields.description: Specifies the approximate order quantity desired in total monetary units vs. as tradeable units (e.g. number of shares). The broker or fund manager (for CIV orders) would be responsible for converting and calculating a tradeable unit (e.g. share) quantity (OrderQty (38)) based upon this amount to be used for the actual order and subsequent messages.

fields.name: allocavgpx
fields.description: AvgPx (6) for a specific AllocAccount (79)

fields.name: allocnetmoney
fields.description: NetMoney(118) for a specific AllocAccount(79).

fields.name: settlcurrfxrate
fields.description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute SettlCurrAmt(119) from Currency(15) to SettlCurrency(120).

fields.name: settlcurrfxratecalc
fields.description: Specifies whether or not SettlCurrFxRate (155) should be multiplied or divided.

fields.name: numdaysinterest
fields.description: Number of Days of Interest for convertible bonds and fixed income. Note value may be negative.

fields.name: accruedinterestrate
fields.description: The amount the buyer compensates the seller for the portion of the next coupon interest payment the seller has earned but will not receive from the issuer because the issuer will send the next coupon payment to the buyer. Accrued Interest Rate is the annualized Accrued Interest amount divided by the purchase price of the bond.

fields.name: accruedinterestamt
fields.description: Amount of Accrued Interest for convertible bonds and fixed income

fields.name: settlinstmode
fields.description: Indicates mode used for Settlement Instructions message. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" ***

fields.name: alloctext
fields.description: Free format text related to a specific AllocAccount (79).

fields.name: settlinstid
fields.description: Unique identifier for Settlement Instruction.

fields.name: settlinsttranstype
fields.description: Settlement Instructions message transaction type

fields.name: emailthreadid
fields.description: Unique identifier for an email thread (new and chain of replies)

fields.name: settlinstsource
fields.description: Indicates source of Settlement Instructions

fields.name: securitytype
fields.description: Indicates type of security. Security type enumerations are grouped by Product(460) field value. NOTE: Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

fields.name: effectivetime
fields.description: Time the details within the message should take effect (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

fields.name: standinstdbtype
fields.description: Identifies the Standing Instruction database used

fields.name: standinstdbname
fields.description: Name of the Standing Instruction database represented with StandInstDbType (169) (i.e. the Global Custodian's name).

fields.name: standinstdbid
fields.description: Unique identifier used on the Standing Instructions database for the Standing Instructions to be referenced.

fields.name: settldeliverytype
fields.description: Identifies type of settlement

fields.name: bidspotrate
fields.description: Bid F/X spot rate.

fields.name: bidforwardpoints
fields.description: Bid F/X forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

fields.name: offerspotrate
fields.description: Offer F/X spot rate.

fields.name: offerforwardpoints
fields.description: Offer F/X forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

fields.name: orderqty2
fields.description: OrderQty (38) of the future part of a F/X swap order.

fields.name: settldate2
fields.description: SettDate (64) of the future part of a F/X swap order.

fields.name: lastspotrate
fields.description: F/X spot rate.

fields.name: lastforwardpoints
fields.description: F/X forward points added to LastSpotRate(194). May be a negative value. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199.

fields.name: alloclinkid
fields.description: Can be used to link two different Allocation messages (each with unique AllocID (70)) together, i.e. for F/X "Netting" or "Swaps". Should be unique.

fields.name: alloclinktype
fields.description: Identifies the type of Allocation linkage when AllocLinkID(196) is used.

fields.name: secondaryorderid
fields.description: Assigned by the party which accepts the order. Can be used to provide the OrderID (37) used by an exchange or executing system.

fields.name: noioiqualifiers
fields.description: Number of repeating groups of IOIQualifiers (04).

fields.name: maturitymonthyear
fields.description: Can be used with standardized derivatives vs. the MaturityDate (541) field. Month and Year of the maturity (used for standardized futures and options).

fields.name: putorcall
fields.description: Indicates whether an option contract is a put, call, chooser or undetermined.

fields.name: strikeprice
fields.description: Strike Price for an Option.

fields.name: coveredoruncovered
fields.description: Used for derivative products, such as options

fields.name: optattribute
fields.description: Provided to support versioning of option contracts as a result of corporate actions or events. Use of this field is defined by counterparty agreement or market conventions.

fields.name: securityexchange
fields.description: Market used to help identify a security.

fields.name: notifybrokerofcredit
fields.description: Indicates whether or not details should be communicated to BrokerOfCredit (i.e. step-in broker).

fields.name: allochandlinst
fields.description: Indicates how the receiver (i.e. third party) of allocation information should handle/process the account details.

fields.name: maxshow
fields.description: Maximum quantity (e.g. number of shares) within an order to be shown to other customers (i.e. sent via an IOI).

fields.name: pegoffsetvalue
fields.description: Amount (signed) added to the peg for a pegged order in the context of the PegOffsetType (836)

fields.name: xmldatalen
fields.description: Length of the XmlData data block.

fields.name: xmldata
fields.description: Actual XML data stream (e.g. FIXML). See appropriate XML reference (e.g. FIXML). Note: may contain embedded SOH characters.

fields.name: settlinstrefid
fields.description: Reference identifier for the SettlInstID (162) with Cancel and Replace SettlInstTransType (163) transaction types.

fields.name: noroutingids
fields.description: Number of repeating groups of RoutingID (217) and RoutingType (216) values.

fields.name: routingtype
fields.description: Indicates the type of RoutingID (217) specified.

fields.name: routingid
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify a specific routing destination.

fields.name: spread
fields.description: For Fixed Income. Either Swap Spread or Spread to Benchmark depending upon the order type.

fields.name: benchmarkcurvecurrency
fields.description: Specifies currency used for benchmark curve.

fields.name: benchmarkcurvename
fields.description: Name of benchmark curve.

fields.name: benchmarkcurvepoint
fields.description: Point on benchmark curve. Free form values: e.g. "Y", "7Y", "INTERPOLATED".

fields.name: couponrate
fields.description: The rate of interest that, when multiplied by the principal, par value, or face value of a bond, provides the currency amount of the periodic interest payment. The coupon is always cited, along with maturity, in any quotation of a bond's price.

fields.name: couponpaymentdate
fields.description: Date interest is to be paid. Used in identifying Corporate Bond issues.

fields.name: issuedate
fields.description: The date on which a bond or stock offering is issued. It may or may not be the same as the effective date ("Dated Date") or the date on which interest begins to accrue ("Interest Accrual Date")

fields.name: repurchaseterm
fields.description: Number of business days before repurchase of a repo. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: repurchaserate
fields.description: Percent of par at which a Repo will be repaid. Represented as a percent, e.g. .9525 represents 95-/4 percent of par. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: factor
fields.description: For Fixed Income: Amorization Factor for deriving Current face from Original face for ABS or MBS securities, note the fraction may be greater than, equal to or less than . In TIPS securities this is the Inflation index.

fields.name: tradeoriginationdate
fields.description: Used with Fixed Income for Muncipal New Issue Market. Agreement in principal between counter-parties prior to actual trade date.

fields.name: exdate
fields.description: The date when a distribution of interest is deducted from a securities assets or set aside for payment to bondholders. On the ex-date, the securities price drops by the amount of the distribution (plus or minus any market activity).

fields.name: contractmultiplier
fields.description: Specifies the ratio or multiply factor to convert from "nominal" units (e.g. contracts) to total units (e.g. shares) (e.g. 1.0, 100, 1000, etc). Applicable For Fixed Income, Convertible Bonds, Derivatives, etc.

fields.name: nostipulations
fields.description: Number of stipulation entries

fields.name: stipulationtype
fields.description: For Fixed Income.

fields.name: stipulationvalue
fields.description: For Fixed Income. Value of stipulation.

fields.name: yieldtype
fields.description: Type of yield. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: yield
fields.description: Yield percentage.

fields.name: totaltakedown
fields.description: The price at which the securities are distributed to the different members of an underwriting group for the primary market in Municipals, total gross underwriter's spread.

fields.name: concession
fields.description: Provides the reduction in price for the secondary market in Muncipals.

fields.name: repocollateralsecuritytype
fields.description: Identifies the collateral used in the transaction.

fields.name: redemptiondate
fields.description: Return of investor's principal in a security. Bond redemption can occur before maturity date.(Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3) (prior to FIX 4.4 field was of type UTCDate)

fields.name: underlyingcouponpaymentdate
fields.description: Underlying security's CouponPaymentDate.

fields.name: underlyingissuedate
fields.description: Underlying security's IssueDate.

fields.name: underlyingrepocollateralsecuritytype
fields.description: Underlying security's RepoCollateralSecurityType. See RepoCollateralSecurityType (239) field for description.(Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: underlyingrepurchaseterm
fields.description: Underlying security's RepurchaseTerm. See RepurchaseTerm (226) field for description (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: underlyingrepurchaserate
fields.description: Underlying security's RepurchaseRate. See RepurchaseRate (227) field for description (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: underlyingfactor
fields.description: Underlying security's Factor.

fields.name: underlyingredemptiondate
fields.description: Underlying security's RedemptionDate. See RedemptionDate (240) field for description (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3) (prior to FIX 4.4 field was of type UTCDate)

fields.name: legcouponpaymentdate
fields.description: Multileg instrument's individual leg security's CouponPaymentDate.

fields.name: legissuedate
fields.description: Multileg instrument's individual leg security's IssueDate.

fields.name: legrepocollateralsecuritytype
fields.description: Multileg instrument's individual leg security's RepoCollateralSecurityType. See RepoCollateralSecurityType (239) field for description (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: legrepurchaseterm
fields.description: Multileg instrument's individual leg security's RepurchaseTerm. See RepurchaseTerm (226) field for description (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: legrepurchaserate
fields.description: Multileg instrument's individual leg security's RepurchaseRate. See RepurchaseRate (227) field for description (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

fields.name: legfactor
fields.description: Multileg instrument's individual leg security's Factor.

fields.name: legredemptiondate
fields.description: Multileg instrument's individual leg security's RedemptionDate. See RedemptionDate (240) field for description (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3) (prior to FIX 4.4 field was of type UTCDate)

fields.description: Total amount traded expressed in units of currency - usually quantity * price. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when quantity fields are expressed in terms of contract size (i.e. quantity * price * contract size).

fields.name: listexecinsttype

fields.name: cxlrejresponseto

fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ListStatusText (444) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ListStatusText field.

fields.description: Identifies class or source of the SecurityAltID(455) value.

fields.description: Alternate Security identifier value for this underlying security of UnderlyingSecurityAltIDSource (459) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires UnderlyingSecurityAltIDSource.

fields.name: underlyingsecurityaltidsource
fields.description: Identifies class or source of the UnderlyingSecurityAltID(458) value.

ISO 10962 is maintained by ANNA (Association of National Numbering Agencies) acting as Registration Authority. See "Appendix 6-B FIX Fields Based Upon Other Standards". See also the Product (460) and SecurityType (167) fields. It is recommended that CFICode be used instead of SecurityType (167) for non-Fixed Income instruments.

fields.name: underlyingproduct
fields.description: Underlying security's Product.

fields.name: underlyingcficode
fields.description: Underlying security's CFICode.

fields.name: testmessageindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether or not this FIX Session is a "test" vs. "production" connection. Useful for preventing "accidents".

fields.name: bookingrefid
fields.description: Common reference passed to a post-trade booking process (e.g. industry matching utility).

fields.name: individualallocid
fields.description: Unique identifier for a specific NoAllocs (78) repeating group instance (e.g. for an AllocAccount).

fields.name: roundingdirection
fields.description: Specifies which direction to round For CIV - indicates whether or not the quantity of shares/units is to be rounded and in which direction where CashOrdQty (152) or (for CIV only) OrderPercent (516) are specified on an order.

fields.name: roundingmodulus
fields.description: For CIV - a float value indicating the value to which rounding is required.

fields.name: countryofissue
fields.description: ISO Country code of instrument issue (e.g. the country portion typically used in ISIN). Can be used in conjunction with non-ISIN SecurityID (48) (e.g. CUSIP for Municipal Bonds without ISIN) to provide uniqueness.

fields.name: stateorprovinceofissue
fields.description: A two-character state or province abbreviation.

fields.name: localeofissue
fields.description: Identifies the locale or region of issue.

fields.name: noregistdtls
fields.description: The number of registration details on a Registration Instructions message

fields.name: mailingdtls
fields.description: Set of Correspondence address details, possibly including phone, fax, etc.

fields.name: investorcountryofresidence

fields.name: paymentref

fields.name: distribpaymentmethod
fields.description: Identifies the payment method for a (fractional) distribution. Used for CIV.

fields.name: cashdistribcurr
fields.description: Specifies currency to be used for Cash Distributions see "Appendix 6-A Valid Currency Codes".

fields.name: commcurrency
fields.description: Specifies currency to be used for Commission(12) if the commission currency is different from the deal currency.

fields.name: cancellationrights
fields.description: For CIV - A one character code identifying whether Cancellation rights/Cooling off period applies.

fields.name: moneylaunderingstatus

fields.name: mailinginst
fields.description: Free format text to specify mailing instruction requirements, e.g. "no third party mailings".

fields.name: transbkdtime
fields.description: For CIV A date and time stamp to indicate the time a CIV order was booked by the fund manager.

fields.name: execpricetype
fields.description: For CIV - Identifies how the execution price LastPx (31) was calculated from the fund unit/share price(s) calculated at the fund valuation point.

fields.name: execpriceadjustment
fields.description: For CIV the amount or percentage by which the fund unit/share price was adjusted, as indicated by ExecPriceType (484)

fields.name: dateofbirth

fields.name: tradereporttranstype
fields.description: Identifies Trade Report message transaction type

fields.name: cardholdername

fields.name: cardnumber

fields.name: cardexpdate

fields.name: paymentmethod
fields.description: Identifies the settlement payment method.

fields.name: registaccttype
fields.description: For CIV - a fund manager-defined code identifying which of the fund manager's account types is required.

fields.name: designation
fields.description: Free format text defining the designation to be associated with a holding on the register. Used to identify assets of a specific underlying investor using a common registration, e.g. a broker's nominee or street name.

fields.name: taxadvantagetype
fields.description: Identifies the type of tax exempt account in which purchases shares/units are to be held. Used for CIV.

fields.name: registrejreasontext
fields.description: Text indicating reason(s) why a Registration Instruction has been rejected.

fields.name: fundrenewwaiv
fields.description: A one character code identifying whether the Fund based renewal commission is to be waived.

fields.name: cashdistribagentname

fields.name: cashdistribagentcode

fields.name: cashdistribagentacctnumber
fields.description: Account number at agent bank for distributions.

fields.name: cashdistribpayref
fields.description: Free format Payment reference to assist with reconciliation of distributions.

fields.name: cashdistribagentacctname
fields.description: Name of account at agent bank for distributions.

fields.name: cardstartdate
fields.description: The start date of the card as specified on the card being used for payment.

fields.name: paymentdate
fields.description: The date written on a cheque or date payment should be submitted to the relevant clearing system.

fields.name: paymentremitterid
fields.description: Identifies sender of a payment, e.g. the payment remitter or a customer reference number.

fields.name: registstatus
fields.description: Registration status as returned by the broker or (for CIV) the fund manager:

fields.name: registrejreasoncode
fields.description: Reason(s) why Registration Instructions has been rejected.

fields.name: custdirectedorder

fields.name: receiveddeptid
fields.description: Identifies the broker-dealer department that first took the order.

fields.name: custorderhandlinginst
fields.description: Codes that apply special information that the Broker / Dealer needs to report, as specified by the customer.

fields.name: orderhandlinginstsource
fields.description: Identifies the class or source of the order handling instruction values. Scope of this will apply to both CustOrderHandlingInst(1031) and DeskOrderHandlingInst(1035).

fields.name: desktype
fields.description: Identifies the type of Trading Desk.

fields.name: desktypesource
fields.description: Identifies the class or source of DeskType(1033) values. Conditionally required when DeskType(1033) is specified.

fields.name: deskorderhandlinginst
fields.description: Codes that apply special information that the broker-dealer needs to report.

fields.name: execackstatus
fields.description: The status of this execution acknowledgement message.

fields.name: underlyingdeliveryamount
fields.description: Indicates the underlying position amount to be delivered

fields.name: underlyingcapvalue
fields.description: Maximum notional value for a capped financial instrument

fields.name: underlyingsettlmethod
fields.description: Settlement method for a contract or instrument. Additional values may be used with bilateral agreement.

fields.name: secondarytradeid
fields.description: Used to carry an internal trade entity ID which may or may not be reported to the firm

fields.name: firmtradeid
fields.description: The ID assigned to a trade by the Firm to track a trade within the Firm system. This ID can be assigned either before or after submission to the exchange or central counterpary

fields.name: secondaryfirmtradeid
fields.description: Used to carry an internal firm assigned ID which may or may not be reported to the exchange or central counterpary

fields.name: collappltype
fields.description: conveys how the collateral should be/has been applied

fields.name: underlyingadjustedquantity
fields.description: Unit amount of the underlying security (shares) adjusted for pending corporate action not yet allocated.

fields.name: underlyingfxrate
fields.description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute UnderlyingCurrentValue(885) (or market value) from UnderlyingCurrency(318) to Currency(15).

fields.name: underlyingfxratecalc
fields.description: Specifies whether the UnderlyingFxRate(1045) should be multiplied or divided.

fields.name: allocpositioneffect
fields.description: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together.

fields.name: dealingcapacity
fields.description: Identifies role of dealer in the trade.

fields.name: instrmtassignmentmethod
fields.description: Method under which assignment was conducted

fields.name: instrumentpartyidsource
fields.description: PartyIDSource value within an instrument partyrepeating group.

fields.name: instrumentpartyrole
fields.description: PartyRole value within an instrument partyepeating group.

fields.name: noinstrumentpartysubids
fields.description: Number of InstrumentPartySubID (1053) and InstrumentPartySubIDType (1054) entries

fields.name: instrumentpartysubid
fields.description: PartySubID value within an instrument party repeating group.

fields.name: instrumentpartysubidtype
fields.description: Type of InstrumentPartySubID (1053) value.

fields.name: positioncurrency
fields.description: The Currency in which the position Amount is denominated

fields.name: calculatedccylastqty
fields.description: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency trade. Can be derived from LastQty and LastPx.

fields.name: aggressorindicator
fields.description: Used to identify whether the order initiator is an aggressor or not in the trade.

fields.name: noundlyinstrumentparties
fields.description: Identifies the number of parties identified with an underlying instrument

fields.name: underlyinginstrumentpartyid
fields.description: PartyID value within an underlying instrument party repeating group.

fields.name: underlyinginstrumentpartyidsource
fields.description: PartyIDSource value within an underlying instrument partyrepeating group.

fields.name: underlyinginstrumentpartyrole
fields.description: PartyRole value within an underlying instrument partyepeating group.

fields.name: noundlyinstrumentpartysubids
fields.description: Number of Underlying InstrumentPartySubID (1053) and InstrumentPartySubIDType (1054) entries

fields.name: underlyinginstrumentpartysubid
fields.description: PartySubID value within an underlying instrument party repeating group.

fields.name: underlyinginstrumentpartysubidtype
fields.description: Type of underlying InstrumentPartySubID (1053) value.

fields.name: bidswappoints
fields.description: The bid FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far bid forward points - near offer forward point". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

fields.name: offerswappoints
fields.description: The offer FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far offer forward points - near bid forward points". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

fields.name: legbidforwardpoints
fields.description: The bid FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

fields.name: legofferforwardpoints
fields.description: The offer FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

fields.name: swappoints
fields.description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

fields.name: mdquotetype
fields.description: Identifies market data quote type.

fields.name: lastswappoints
fields.description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the last market event for the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer in a fill or partial fill. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

fields.name: sidegrosstradeamt
fields.description: The gross trade amount for this side of the trade. See also GrossTradeAmt (381) for additional definition.

fields.name: leglastforwardpoints
fields.description: The forward points for this leg's fill event. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

fields.name: legcalculatedccylastqty
fields.description: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency for this leg. Can be derived from LegQty and LegLastPx.

fields.name: leggrosstradeamt
fields.description: The gross trade amount of the leg. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when LegLastQty and other quantity fields are express in terms of contract size.

fields.name: maturitytime
fields.description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

fields.name: reforderid
fields.description: The ID reference to the order being hit or taken.

fields.name: reforderidsource
fields.description: Used to specify the source for the identifier in RefOrderID(1080). This can be an identifier provided in order depth market data when hitting (taking) a specific order or to identify what type of order or quote reference is being provided when seeking credit limit check. In the context of US CAT this can be used to identify related orders and quotes which are parent, previous, or manual orders or quotes. Previous relates to orders changing their unique system assigned order identifier.

fields.name: secondarydisplayqty
fields.description: Used for reserve orders when DisplayQty applies to the primary execution market (e.g.an ECN) and another quantity is to be shown at other markets (e.g. the exchange). On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

fields.name: displaywhen
fields.description: Instructs when to refresh DisplayQty (1138).

fields.name: displaymethod
fields.description: Defines what value to use in DisplayQty (1138). If not specified the default DisplayMethod is "1"

fields.name: displaylowqty
fields.description: Defines the lower quantity limit to a randomized refresh of DisplayQty.

fields.name: displayhighqty
fields.description: Defines the upper quantity limit to a randomized refresh of DisplayQty.

fields.name: displayminincr
fields.description: Defines the minimum increment to be used when calculating a random refresh of DisplayQty. A user specifies this when he wants a larger increment than the standard provided by the market (e.g. the round lot size).

fields.name: refreshqty
fields.description: Defines the quantity used to refresh DisplayQty.

fields.name: matchincrement
fields.description: Allows orders to specify a minimum quantity that applies to every execution (one execution could be for multiple counter-orders). The order may still fill against smaller orders, but the cumulative quantity of the execution must be in multiples of the MatchIncrement.

fields.name: maxpricelevels
fields.description: Allows an order to specify a maximum number of price levels to trade through. Only valid for aggressive orders and during continuous (autoexecution) trading sessions. Property lost when order is put on book. A partially filled order is assigned last trade price as limit price. Non-filled order behaves as ordinary Market or Limit.

fields.name: pretradeanonymity
fields.description: Allows trader to explicitly request anonymity or disclosure in pre-trade market data feeds. Anonymity is relevant in markets where counterparties are regularly disclosed in order depth feeds. Disclosure is relevant when counterparties are not normally visible.

fields.name: priceprotectionscope
fields.description: Defines the type of price protection the customer requires on their order.

fields.name: lottype
fields.description: Defines the lot type assigned to the order.

fields.name: pegpricetype
fields.description: Defines the type of peg.

fields.name: peggedrefprice
fields.description: The value of the reference price that the order is pegged to. PeggedRefPrice + PegOffsetValue (211) = PeggedPrice (839) unless the limit price (44, Price) is breached. The values may not be exact due to rounding.

fields.name: pegsecurityidsource
fields.description: Defines the identity of the security off whose prices the order will peg. Same values as SecurityIDSource (22)

fields.name: pegsecurityid
fields.description: Defines the identity of the security off whose prices the order will peg.

fields.name: pegsymbol
fields.description: Defines the common, 'human understood' representation of the security off whose prices the order will Peg.

fields.name: pegsecuritydesc
fields.description: Security description of the security off whose prices the order will Peg.

fields.name: triggertype
fields.description: Defines when the trigger will hit, i.e. the action specified by the trigger instructions will come into effect.

fields.name: triggeraction
fields.description: Defines the type of action to take when the trigger hits.

fields.name: triggerprice
fields.description: The price at which the trigger should hit.

fields.name: triggersymbol
fields.description: Defines the common, 'human understood' representation of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

fields.name: triggersecurityid
fields.description: Defines the identity of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

fields.name: triggersecurityidsource
fields.description: Defines the identity of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic. Same values as SecurityIDSource (22).

fields.name: triggersecuritydesc
fields.description: Defines the security description of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

fields.name: triggerpricetype
fields.description: The type of price that the trigger is compared to.

fields.name: triggerpricetypescope
fields.description: Defines the type of price protection the customer requires on their order.

fields.name: triggerpricedirection
fields.description: The side from which the trigger price is reached.

fields.name: triggernewprice
fields.description: The Price that the order should have after the trigger has hit. Could be applicable for any trigger type, but must be specified for Trigger Type 1.

fields.name: triggerordertype
fields.description: The OrdType the order should have after the trigger has hit. Required to express orders that change from Limit to Market. Other values from OrdType (40) may be used if appropriate and bilaterally agreed upon.

fields.name: triggernewqty
fields.description: The Quantity the order should have after the trigger has hit.

fields.name: triggertradingsessionid
fields.description: Defines the trading session at which the order will be activated.

fields.name: triggertradingsessionsubid
fields.description: Defines the subordinate trading session at which the order will be activated.

fields.name: ordercategory
fields.description: Defines the type of interest behind a trade (fill or partial fill).

fields.name: norootpartyids
fields.description: Number of RootPartyID (1117), RootPartyIDSource (1118), and RootPartyRole (1119) entries

fields.name: rootpartyid
fields.description: PartyID value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyID (448)

fields.name: rootpartyidsource
fields.description: PartyIDSource value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyIDSource (447)

fields.name: rootpartyrole
fields.description: PartyRole value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyRole (452)

fields.name: norootpartysubids
fields.description: Number of RootPartySubID (1121) and RootPartySubIDType (1122) entries

fields.name: rootpartysubid
fields.description: PartySubID value within a root parties component. Same values as PartySubID (523)

fields.name: rootpartysubidtype
fields.description: Type of RootPartySubID (1121) value. Same values as PartySubIDType (803)

fields.name: tradehandlinginstr
fields.description: Specified how the TradeCaptureReport(35=AE) should be handled by the respondent.

fields.name: origtradehandlinginstr
fields.description: Optionally used with TradeHandlingInstr = 0 to relay the trade handling instruction used when reporting the trade to the marketplace. Same values as TradeHandlingInstr (1123)

fields.name: origtradedate
fields.description: Used to preserve original trade date when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

fields.name: origtradeid
fields.description: Used to preserve original trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

fields.name: origsecondarytradeid
fields.description: Used to preserve original secondary trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

fields.name: applverid
fields.description: Specifies the application layer version being applied at the message level.

fields.name: cstmapplverid
fields.description: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the message level. Enumerated field

fields.name: refapplverid
fields.description: Specifies the service pack release being applied to a message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID

fields.name: refcstmapplverid
fields.description: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the session level.

fields.name: tztransacttime
fields.description: Transact time in the local date-time stamp with a TZ offset to UTC identified

fields.name: exdestinationidsource
fields.description: The ID source of ExDestination

fields.name: reportedpxdiff
fields.description: Indicates that the reported price that is different from the market price. The price difference should be stated by using field 828 TrdType and, if required, field 829 TrdSubType

fields.name: rptsys
fields.description: Indicates the system or medium on which the report has been published

fields.name: allocclearingfeeindicator
fields.description: ClearingFeeIndicator(635) for Allocation, see ClearingFeeIndicator(635) for permitted values.

fields.name: defaultapplverid
fields.description: Specifies the service pack release being applied, by default, to message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID

fields.name: displayqty
fields.description: The quantity to be displayed . Required for reserve orders. On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

fields.name: exchangespecialinstructions
fields.description: Free format text string related to exchange.

fields.name: maxtradevol
fields.description: The maximum order quantity (as expressed by TradeVolType(1786)) that can be submitted for a security.

fields.name: nomdfeedtypes
fields.description: The number of feed types and corresponding book depths associated with a security

fields.name: matchalgorithm
fields.description: The types of algorithm used to match orders in a specific security. Possilbe value types are FIFO, Allocation, Pro-rata, Lead Market Maker, Currency Calender.

fields.name: maxpricevariation
fields.description: The maximum price variation of an execution from one event to the next for a given security. Expressed in absolute price terms.

fields.name: impliedmarketindicator
fields.description: Indicates that an implied market should be created for either the legs of a multi-leg instrument (Implied-in) or for the multi-leg instrument based on the existence of the legs (Implied-out). Determination as to whether implied markets should be created is generally done at the level of the multi-leg instrument. Commonly used in listed derivatives.

fields.name: eventtime
fields.description: Specific time of event. To be used in combination with EventDate [866]

fields.name: minpriceincrementamount
fields.description: Minimum price increment amount associated with MinPriceIncrement(969). For listed derivatives, the value can be calculated by multiplying MinPriceIncrement(969) with ContractMultiplier(231).

fields.name: unitofmeasureqty
fields.description: Used to indicate the quantity of the underlying commodity unit of measure on which the contract is based, such as, 2500 lbs of lean cattle, 1000 barrels of crude oil, 1000 bushels of corn, etc. UnitOfMeasureQty is required for UnitOfMeasure(996) Variable Quantity UOMs enumerations. Refer to the definition of UnitOfMeasure(996) for more information on the use of UnitOfMeasureQty.

fields.name: lowlimitprice
fields.description: Allowable low limit price for the trading day. A key parameter in validating order price. Used as the lower band for validating order prices. Orders submitted with prices below the lower limit will be rejected

fields.name: highlimitprice
fields.description: Allowable high limit price for the trading day. A key parameter in validating order price. Used as the upper band for validating order prices. Orders submitted with prices above the upper limit will be rejected

fields.name: tradingreferenceprice
fields.description: Reference price for the current trading price range usually representing the mid price between the HighLimitPrice and LowLimitPrice. The value may be the settlement price or closing price of the prior trading day.

fields.name: securitygroup
fields.description: An exchange specific name assigned to a group of related securities which may be concurrently affected by market events and actions.

fields.name: legnumber
fields.description: Allow sequencing of Legs for a Strategy to be captured

fields.name: settlementcycleno
fields.description: Settlement cycle in which the settlement obligation was generated

fields.name: sidecurrency
fields.description: Used to identify the trading currency on the Trade Capture Report Side

fields.name: sidesettlcurrency
fields.description: Used to identify the settlement currency on the Trade Capture Report Side

fields.name: applextid
fields.description: The extension pack number associated with an application message.

fields.name: ccyamt
fields.description: Net flow of Currency 1

fields.name: nosettldetails
fields.description: Used to group Each Settlement Party

fields.name: settlobligmode
fields.description: Used to identify the reporting mode of the settlement obligation which is either preliminary or final

fields.name: settlobligmsgid
fields.description: Message identifier for Settlement Obligation Report

fields.name: settlobligid
fields.description: Unique ID for this settlement instruction.

fields.name: settlobligtranstype
fields.description: Transaction Type - required except where SettlInstMode is 5=Reject SSI request

fields.name: settlobligrefid
fields.description: Required where SettlInstTransType is Cancel or Replace

fields.name: settlobligsource
fields.description: Used to identify whether these delivery instructions are for the buyside or the sellside.

fields.name: nosettloblig
fields.description: Number of settlement obligations

fields.name: quotemsgid
fields.description: Unique identifier for a quote message.

fields.name: quoteentrystatus
fields.description: Identifies the status of an individual quote. See also QuoteStatus(297) which is used for single Quotes.

fields.name: totnocxldquotes
fields.description: Specifies the number of canceled quotes

fields.name: totnoaccquotes
fields.description: Specifies the number of accepted quotes

fields.name: totnorejquotes
fields.description: Specifies the number of rejected quotes

fields.name: privatequote
fields.description: Specifies whether a quote is public, i.e. available to the market, or private, i.e. available to a specified counterparty only.

fields.name: respondenttype
fields.description: Specifies the type of respondents requested.

fields.name: mdsubbooktype
fields.description: Describes a class of sub book, e.g. for the separation of various lot types. The Sub Book Type indicates that the following Market Data Entries belong to a non-integrated Sub Book. Whenever provided the Sub Book must be used together with MDPriceLevel and MDEntryPositionNo in order to sort the order properly.

fields.name: securitytradingevent
fields.description: Identifies an event related to a SecurityTradingStatus(326). An event occurs and is gone, it is not a state that applies for a period of time.

fields.name: nostatsindicators
fields.description: Number of statistics indicator repeating group entries

fields.name: statstype
fields.description: Type of statistics

fields.name: noofsecsizes
fields.description: The number of secondary sizes specifies in this entry

fields.name: mdsecsizetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of secondary size.

fields.name: mdsecsize
fields.description: A part of the MDEntrySize(271) that represents secondary interest as specified by MDSecSizeType(1178).

fields.name: applid
fields.description: Identifies the application with which a message is associated. Used only if application sequencing is in effect.

fields.name: applseqnum
fields.description: Data sequence number to be used when FIX session is not in effect

fields.name: applbegseqnum
fields.description: Beginning range of application sequence numbers

fields.name: applendseqnum
fields.description: Ending range of application sequence numbers

fields.name: securityxmllen
fields.description: The length of the SecurityXML(1185) data block.

fields.name: securityxml
fields.description: XML definition for the security.

fields.name: securityxmlschema
fields.description: The schema used to validate the contents of SecurityXML(1185).

fields.name: refreshindicator
fields.description: Set by the sender to tell the receiver to perform an immediate refresh of the book due to disruptions in the accompanying real-time feed

fields.name: volatility
fields.description: Annualized volatility for option model calculations

fields.name: timetoexpiration
fields.description: Time to expiration in years calculated as the number of days remaining to expiration divided by 365 days per year.

fields.name: riskfreerate
fields.description: Interest rate. Usually some form of short term rate.

fields.name: priceunitofmeasure
fields.description: Used to express the UOM of the price if different from the contract. In futures, this can be different for cross-rate products in which the price is quoted in units differently from the contract

fields.name: priceunitofmeasureqty
fields.description: Used to express the UOM Quantity of the price if different from the contract. In futures, this can be different for physically delivered products in which price is quoted in a unit size different from the contract, i.e. a Cattle Future contract has a UOMQty of 40,000 and a PriceUOMQty of 100.

fields.name: settlmethod
fields.description: Settlement method for a contract or instrument. Additional values may be used with bilateral agreement.

fields.name: exercisestyle
fields.description: Type of exercise of a derivatives security

fields.name: optpayoutamount
fields.description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

fields.name: pricequotemethod
fields.description: Method for price quotation

fields.name: valuationmethod
fields.description: Specifies the type of valuation method applied.

fields.name: listmethod
fields.description: Indicates whether instruments are pre-listed only or can also be defined via user request

fields.name: capprice
fields.description: Used to express the ceiling price of a capped call

fields.name: floorprice
fields.description: Used to express the floor price of a capped put

fields.name: nostrikerules
fields.description: Number of strike rule entries. This block specifies the rules for determining how new strikes should be listed within the stated price range of the underlying instrument

fields.name: startstrikepxrange
fields.description: Starting price for the range to which the StrikeIncrement applies. Price refers to the price of the underlying

fields.name: endstrikepxrange
fields.description: Ending price of the range to which the StrikeIncrement applies. Price refers to the price of the underlying

fields.name: strikeincrement
fields.description: Value by which strike price should be incremented within the specified price range.

fields.name: notickrules
fields.description: Number of tick rules. This block specifies the rules for determining how a security ticks, i.e. the price increments at which it can be quoted and traded, depending on the current price of the security

fields.name: starttickpricerange
fields.description: Starting price range for specified tick increment

fields.name: endtickpricerange
fields.description: Ending price range for the specified tick increment

fields.name: tickincrement
fields.description: Tick increment for stated price range. Specifies the valid price increments at which a security can be quoted and traded

fields.name: tickruletype
fields.description: Specifies the type of tick rule which is being described

fields.name: nestedinstrattribtype
fields.description: Code to represent the type of instrument attribute

fields.name: nestedinstrattribvalue
fields.description: Attribute value appropriate to the NestedInstrAttribType field

fields.name: legmaturitytime
fields.description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

fields.name: underlyingmaturitytime
fields.description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

fields.name: derivativesymbol
fields.description: Ticker symbol. Common, human understood representation of the security.

fields.name: derivativesymbolsfx
fields.description: Additional information about the security (e.g. preferred, warrants, etc.).

fields.name: derivativesecurityid
fields.description: Security identifier value (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc).

fields.name: derivativesecurityidsource
fields.description: Identifies class or source of the DerivativeSecurityID(1217) value.

fields.name: noderivativesecurityaltid
fields.description: Number of alternate derivative security IDs.

fields.name: derivativesecurityaltid
fields.description: Alternate derivative security identifier value of DerivativeSecurityAltIDSource(1220) type.

fields.name: derivativesecurityaltidsource
fields.description: Identifies class or source of the DerivativeSecurityAltID(1219) value.

fields.name: secondarylowlimitprice
fields.description: Refer to definition of LowLimitPrice(1148)

fields.name: maturityruleid
fields.description: Allows maturity rule to be referenced via an identifier so that rules do not need to be explicitly enumerated

fields.name: strikeruleid
fields.description: Allows strike rule to be referenced via an identifier so that rules do not need to be explicitly enumerated

fields.name: legunitofmeasureqty
fields.description: Refer to definition of UnitOfMeasureQty(1147)

fields.name: derivativeoptpayoutamount
fields.description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

fields.name: endmaturitymonthyear
fields.description: Ending maturity month year for an option class

fields.name: productcomplex
fields.description: Identifies an entire suite of products for a given market. In Futures this may be "interest rates", "agricultural", "equity indexes", etc.

fields.name: derivativeproductcomplex
fields.description: Identifies an entire suite of products for a given market.

fields.name: maturitymonthyearincrement
fields.description: Increment between successive maturities for an option class

fields.name: secondaryhighlimitprice
fields.description: Refer to definition of HighLimitPrice(1149)

fields.name: minlotsize
fields.description: Minimum lot size allowed based on lot type specified in LotType(1093)

fields.name: noexecinstrules
fields.description: Number of execution instructions

fields.name: commrate
fields.description: The commission rate when Commission(12) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". If the rate is a percentage, use the decimalized form, e.g. "0.05" for a 5% commission or "0.005" for 50 basis points.

fields.name: nolottyperules
fields.description: Number of Lot Type Rules

fields.name: nomatchrules
fields.description: Number of Match Rules

fields.name: nomaturityrules
fields.description: Number of maturity rules in MarurityRules component block

fields.name: noordtyperules
fields.description: Number of order types

fields.name: communitofmeasure
fields.description: The commission rate unit of measure.

fields.name: notimeinforcerules
fields.description: Number of time in force techniques

fields.name: secondarytradingreferenceprice
fields.description: Refer to definition for TradingReferencePrice(1150)

fields.name: startmaturitymonthyear
fields.description: Starting maturity month year for an option class

fields.name: flexproducteligibilityindicator
fields.description: Used to indicate if a product or group of product supports the creation of flexible securities

fields.name: derivflexproducteligibilityindicator
fields.description: Used to indicate if a product or group of product supports the creation of flexible securities.

fields.name: flexibleindicator
fields.description: Used to indicate a derivatives security that can be defined using flexible terms. The terms commonly permitted to be defined by market participants are expiration date and strike price. FlexibleIndicator is an alternative CFICode(461) Standard/Non-standard attribute.

fields.name: tradingcurrency
fields.description: Used when the trading currency can differ from the price currency

fields.name: derivativeproduct
fields.description: The type of product the security is associated with.

fields.name: derivativesecuritygroup
fields.description: An exchange specific name assigned to a group of related securities which may be concurrently affected by market events and actions.

fields.name: derivativecficode
fields.description: The type of security using ISO 10962 standard, Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI code) values.

fields.name: derivativesecuritytype
fields.description: The type of security.

fields.name: derivativesecuritysubtype
fields.description: Sub-type qualification/identification of the security type.

fields.name: derivativematuritymonthyear
fields.description: Month and Year of the maturity (used for standardized futures and options).

fields.name: derivativematuritydate
fields.description: Date of maturity.

fields.name: derivativematuritytime
fields.description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified.
