fields.name: lastupfrontprice
fields.description: Price used to determine upfront payment for swaps contracts reported for a deal (trade).

fields.name: appllevelrecoveryindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether application level recovery is needed.

fields.name: bidmdentryid
fields.description: The market data entry identifier of the bid side of a quote

fields.name: offermdentryid
fields.description: The market data entry identifier of the offer side of a quote.

fields.name: bidquoteid
fields.description: Marketplace assigned quote identifier for the bid side. Can be used to indicate priority.

fields.name: offerquoteid
fields.description: Marketplace assigned quote identifier for the offer side. Can be used to indicate priority.

fields.name: totalbidsize
fields.description: Specifies the total bid size.

fields.name: totaloffersize
fields.description: Specifies the total offer size.

fields.name: secondaryquoteid
fields.description: Assigned by the party which accepts the quote. Can be used to provide the quote identifier assigned by an exchange, marketplace or executing system.

fields.name: custodiallotid
fields.description: An opaque identifier used to communicate the custodian’s identifier for the lot. It is expected that this information would be provided by the custodian as part of a reconciliation process that occurs before trading.

fields.name: versuspurchasedate
fields.description: The effective acquisition date of the lot that would be used for gain-loss trade lot reporting. The versus purchase date used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available.

fields.name: versuspurchaseprice
fields.description: The versus purchase price used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available. The value should be calculated based on current cost basis / quantity held.

fields.name: currentcostbasis
fields.description: The amount that the current shares are worth. If this lot was liquidated, the total gain/loss for a trade is equal to the trade amount minus the current cost basis.

fields.name: legcustodiallotid
fields.description: An opaque identifier used to communicate the custodian’s identifier for the lot. It is expected that this information would be provided by the custodian as part of a reconciliation process that occurs before trading.

fields.name: legversuspurchasedate
fields.description: The effective acquisition date of the lot that would be used for gain-loss trade lot reporting. The versus purchase date used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available.

fields.name: legversuspurchaseprice
fields.description: The versus purchase price used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available.The value should be calculated based on current cost basis / quantity held.

fields.name: legcurrentcostbasis
fields.description: The amount that the current shares are worth. If this lot was liquidated, the total gain/loss for a trade is equal to the trade amount minus the current cost basis.

fields.name: risklimitrequesttype
fields.description: Type of risk limit information.

fields.name: risklimitrequestresult
fields.description: Result of risk limit definition request.

fields.name: risklimitrequeststatus
fields.description: Status of risk limit definition request.

fields.name: risklimitstatus
fields.description: Status of risk limit definition for one party.

fields.name: risklimitresult
fields.description: Result of risk limit definition for one party.

fields.name: risklimitutilizationpercent
fields.description: Percentage of utilization of a party's set risk limit.

fields.name: risklimitutilizationamount
fields.description: Absolute amount of utilization of a party's set risk limit.

fields.name: risklimitaction
fields.description: Identifies the action to take or risk model to assume should risk limit be exceeded or breached for the specified party.

fields.name: riskwarninglevelamount
fields.description: Amount at which a warning is issued.

fields.name: riskwarninglevelaction
fields.description: Action to take should warning level be exceeded.

fields.name: entitlementrequestid
fields.description: Unique identifier for PartyEntitlementsRequest(35=CU).

fields.name: entitlementreportid
fields.description: Identifier for the PartyEntitlementsReport(35=CV).

fields.name: nopartyentitlements
fields.description: Number of party entitlement values.

fields.name: noentitlements
fields.description: Number of entitlement values.

fields.name: entitlementindicator
fields.description: Used to indicate if a party is entitled to an entitlement type specified in the EntitlementType(1775) field.

fields.name: entitlementtype
fields.description: Type of entitlement.

fields.name: entitlementid
fields.description: Unique identifier for a specific NoEntitlements(1773) repeating group instance.

fields.name: noentitlementattrib
fields.description: Number of entitlement attributes.

fields.name: entitlementattribtype
fields.description: Name of the entitlement attribute type. A code list of allowed values will be maintained on the FIX Protocol website.

fields.name: entitlementattribdatatype
fields.description: Datatype of the entitlement attribute.

fields.name: entitlementattribvalue
fields.description: Value of the entitlement attribute.

fields.name: entitlementattribcurrency
fields.description: Currency for EntitlementAttribValue(1780). Can be used if these fields represent a price, price offset, or amount.

fields.name: entitlementstartdate
fields.description: Indicates the starting date of the entitlement.

fields.name: entitlementenddate
fields.description: Indicates the ending date of the entitlement.

fields.name: entitlementplatform
fields.description: The area to which the entitlement is applicable. This can be a trading platform or an offering.

fields.name: tradsescontrol
fields.description: Indicates how control of trading session and subsession transitions are performed.

fields.name: tradevoltype
fields.description: Define the type of trade volume applicable for the MinTradeVol(562) and MaxTradeVol(1140)

fields.name: refticktableid
fields.description: Spread table code referred by the security or symbol.

fields.name: legid
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leg within the context of a message (the scope of uniqueness to be defined by counterparty agreement). The LegID(1788) can be referenced using LegRefID(654).

fields.name: notargetmarketsegments
fields.description: Number of market segments upon which a mass action is to be taken.

fields.name: targetmarketsegmentid
fields.description: Market segment within a target market segment repeating group.

fields.name: noaffectedmarketsegments
fields.description: Number of market segments affected by a mass action.

fields.name: affectedmarketsegmentid
fields.description: Market segment within an affected market repeating segment group.

fields.name: nonotaffectedmarketsegments
fields.description: Number of market segments left unaffected by a mass action.

fields.name: notaffectedmarketsegmentid
fields.description: Market segment within an unaffected market repeating segment group.

fields.name: noorderevents
fields.description: Number of order events.

fields.name: ordereventtype
fields.description: The type of event affecting an order. The last event type within the OrderEventGrp component indicates the ExecType(150) value resulting from the series of events (ExecType(150) values are shown in brackets).

fields.name: ordereventexecid
fields.description: Refer to ExecID(17). Used when multiple different events are reported in single Execution Report. ExecID(17) and OrderEventExecID(1797) values should not overlap.

fields.name: ordereventreason
fields.description: Action that caused the event to occur.

fields.name: ordereventpx
fields.description: Price associated with the event.

fields.name: ordereventqty
fields.description: Quantity associated with the event.

fields.name: ordereventliquidityindicator
fields.description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrderEventType(1796) values of 4(Partially Filled) or 5(Filled).

fields.name: ordereventtext
fields.description: Additional information about the event.

fields.name: auctiontype
fields.description: Type of auction order.

fields.name: auctionallocationpct
fields.description: Percentage of matched quantity to be allocated to the submitter of the response to an auction order.

fields.name: auctioninstruction
fields.description: Instruction related to system generated auctions, e.g. flash order auctions.

fields.name: refclordid
fields.description: Used to reference an order via ClOrdID(11).

fields.name: locktype
fields.description: Indicates whether an order is locked and for what reason.

fields.name: lockedqty
fields.description: Locked order quantity.

fields.name: secondarylockedqty
fields.description: Locked order quantity in addition to LockedQty (1808), e.g. to distinguish total locked quantity from currently locked quantity.

fields.name: releaseinstruction
fields.description: Instruction to define conditions under which to release a locked order or parts of it.

fields.name: releaseqty
fields.description: Quantity to be made available, i.e. released from a lock.

fields.name: nodisclosureinstructions
fields.description: Number of disclosure instructions.

fields.name: disclosuretype
fields.description: Information subject to disclosure.

fields.name: disclosureinstruction
fields.description: Instruction to disclose information or to use default value of the receiver.

fields.name: tradingcapacity
fields.description: Designates the capacity in which the order is submitted for trading by the market participant.

fields.name: clearingaccounttype
fields.description: Designates the account type to be used for the order when submitted to clearing.

fields.name: legclearingaccounttype
fields.description: Designates the capacity in which the order will be submitted to clearing.

fields.name: targetpartyrolequalifier
fields.description: Qualifies the value of TargetPartyRole (1464).

fields.name: relatedhighprice
fields.description: Upper boundary for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order.

fields.name: relatedlowprice
fields.description: Lower boundary for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order.

fields.name: relatedpricesource
fields.description: Source for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order. Can be used together with RelatedHighPrice (1819) and/or RelatedLowPrice (1820).

fields.name: minqtymethod
fields.description: Indicates how the minimum quantity should be applied when executing the order.

fields.name: triggered
fields.description: Indicates whether order has been triggered during its lifetime. Applies to cases where original information, e.g. OrdType(40), is modified when the order is triggered.

fields.name: affectedorigclordid
fields.description: OrigClOrdID(41) of an order affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

fields.name: notaffsecondaryorderid
fields.description: SecondaryOrderID (198) of an order not affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

fields.name: eventtimeperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the event.

fields.name: eventtimeunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the event.

fields.name: lastqtyvariance
fields.description: When LastQty is an estimated value, e.g. for a Repo "circled" trade, LastQtyVariance specifies the absolute amount that the size may vary up or down when finalized. Omitted when LastQty(32) is already final.

fields.name: nocrosslegs
fields.description: Number of legs in the side of a cross order.

fields.name: settlpriceincrement
fields.description: Settlement price increment for stated price range.

fields.name: settlpricesecondaryincrement
fields.description: Secondary settlement price increment for stated price range. The meaning of secondary is left to bilateral agreement, e.g. it may refer to final settlement for a contract.

fields.name: clearedindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the trade or position being reported was cleared through a clearing organization.

fields.name: contractrefpostype
fields.description: Additional information related to the pricing of a commodity swaps position, specifically an indicator referring to the position type.

fields.name: positioncapacity
fields.description: Used to describe the ownership of the position.

fields.name: posqtyunitofmeasurecurrency
fields.description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure if position quantity is expressed in valuation rather than contracts. Conditionally required when PosQtyUnitOfMeasure(1836)=Ccy.

fields.name: posqtyunitofmeasure
fields.description: Indicates the unit of measure of the position quantity when not expressed in contracts.

fields.name: underlyingcontractpricerefmonth
fields.description: Reference month if there is no applicable UnderlyingMaturityMonth(313) value for the contract or security.

fields.name: notradepriceconditions
fields.description: Number of trade price conditions.

fields.name: tradepricecondition
fields.description: Price conditions in effect at the time of the trade. Multiple price conditions can be in effect at the same time. Price conditions are usually required to be reported in markets that have regulations on price execution at a market or national best bid or offer, and the trade price differs from the best bid or offer.

fields.name: tradeallocstatus
fields.description: Identifies the status of an allocation when using a pre-clear workflow.

fields.name: notradeqtys
fields.description: Number of trade quantities.

fields.name: tradeqtytype
fields.description: Indicates the type of trade quantity in TradeQty(1843).

fields.name: tradeqty
fields.description: Trade quantity.

fields.name: notradeallocamts
fields.description: Number of trade allocation amount entries.

fields.name: tradeallocamttype
fields.description: Type of the amount associated with a trade allocation.

fields.name: tradeallocamt
fields.description: The amount associated with a trade allocation.

fields.name: tradealloccurrency
fields.description: Currency denomination of the trade allocation amount.

fields.name: tradeallocgroupinstruction
fields.description: Instruction on how to add a trade to an allocation group when it is being given-up.

fields.name: offsetinstruction
fields.description: Indicates the trade is a result of an offset or onset.

fields.name: tradeallocamtreason
fields.description: Specifies the reason for an amount type when reported on an allocation. Useful when multiple instances of the same amount type are reported.

fields.name: strategylinkid
fields.description: Identifies the multileg strategy (e.g. spread) to which the trade belongs. This links together trade legs executed as part of a strategy during a single match event.

fields.name: sideavgpx
fields.description: Calculated average price for this side of the trade.

fields.name: sideavgpxindicator
fields.description: Used to indicate whether a trade or a sub-allocation should be allocated at the trade price (e.g. no average pricing), or whether it should be grouped with other trades/sub-allocations and allocated at the average price of the group.

fields.name: sideavgpxgroupid
fields.description: The identifier for the average price group for the trade side. See also AvgPxGroupID(1731).

fields.name: norelatedtrades
fields.description: Number of related trades.

fields.name: relatedtradeid
fields.description: Identifier of a related trade.

fields.name: relatedtradeidsource
fields.description: Describes the source of the identifier that RelatedTradeID(1856) represents.

fields.name: relatedtradedate
fields.description: Date of a related trade.

fields.name: relatedtrademarketid
fields.description: Market of execution of related trade.

fields.name: relatedtradequantity
fields.description: Quantity of the related trade which can be less than or equal to the actual quantity of the related trade. For example, when one trade offsets another across asset classes.

fields.name: norelatedpositions
fields.description: Number of related positions.

fields.name: relatedpositionid
fields.description: Identifier of a related position.

fields.name: relatedpositionidsource
fields.description: Describes the source of the identifier that RelatedPositionID(1862) represents.

fields.name: relatedpositiondate
fields.description: Used to help identify the position when RelatedPositionID(1862) is not unique across multiple days. This date is generally the creation date of the identifier.

fields.name: quoteackstatus
fields.description: Acknowledgement status of a Quote(35=S) or QuoteCancel(35=Z) message submission.

fields.name: strikeindex
fields.description: Specifies the index used to calculate the strike price.

fields.name: offerid
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ask side of the quote assigned by the quote issuer.

fields.name: novaluechecks
fields.description: Number of value check entries.

fields.name: valuechecktype
fields.description: Type of value to be checked.

fields.name: valuecheckaction
fields.description: Action to be taken for the ValueCheckType(1869).

fields.name: legsecurityxmllen
fields.description: The length of the LegSecurityXML(1872) data block.

fields.name: legsecurityxml
fields.description: XML definition for the leg security.

fields.name: legsecurityxmlschema
fields.description: The schema used to validate the contents of LegSecurityXML(1872).

fields.name: underlyingsecurityxmllen
fields.description: The length of the UnderlyingSecurityXML(1875) data block.

fields.name: underlyingsecurityxml
fields.description: XML definition for the underlying security.

fields.name: underlyingsecurityxmlschema
fields.description: The schema used to validate the contents of UnderlyingSecurityXML(1875).

fields.name: partydetailrequestresult
fields.description: Result party detail definition request.

fields.name: partydetailrequeststatus
fields.description: Status of party details definition request.

fields.name: partydetaildefinitionstatus
fields.description: Status of party detail definition for one party.

fields.name: partydetaildefinitionresult
fields.description: Result of party detail definition for one party.

fields.name: entitlementrequestresult
fields.description: Result of risk limit definition request.

fields.name: entitlementrequeststatus
fields.description: Status of party entitlements definition request.

fields.name: entitlementstatus
fields.description: Status of entitlement definition for one party.

fields.name: entitlementresult
fields.description: Result of entitlement definition for one party.

fields.name: entitlementrefid
fields.description: Reference to an EntitlementID(1776). Used for modification or deletion of an entitlement.

fields.name: settlpriceunitofmeasure
fields.description: Used to express the unit of measure of the settlement price if different from the contract.

fields.name: settlpriceunitofmeasurecurrency
fields.description: Indicates the currency of the settlement price unit of measure if expressed in another currency than the base currency.

fields.name: tradematchtimestamp
fields.description: Timestamp of the match event. For off-exchange trades the time at which the deal was matched by the exchange.

fields.name: noinstrmtmatchsides
fields.description: Number of instrument match sides.

fields.name: notrdmatchsides
fields.description: Number of trade match sides.

fields.name: trdmatchsubid
fields.description: Used to identify each price level, step or clip within a match event.

fields.name: nolegexecs
fields.description: Number of instrument leg executions.

fields.name: legexecid
fields.description: The ExecID(17) value corresponding to a trade leg.

fields.name: legtradeid
fields.description: The TradeID(1003) value corresponding to a trade leg.

fields.name: legtradereportid
fields.description: The TradeReportID(571) value corresponding to a trade leg.

fields.name: tradematchackstatus
fields.description: Used to indicate the status of the trade match report submission.

fields.name: tradematchrejectreason
fields.description: Reason the trade match report submission was rejected.

fields.name: sidemarketsegmentid
fields.description: Identifies the market segment of the side.

fields.name: sidevenuetype
fields.description: Identifies the type of venue where the trade was executed for the side.

fields.name: sideexecrefid
fields.description: Used to reference the value from SideExecID(1427).

fields.name: legexecrefid
fields.description: Used to reference the value from LegExecID(1893).

fields.name: haircutindicator
fields.description: Indicates, if "Y", that a stated valuation includes a haircut, e.g. that the stated value reflects the subtraction of the haircut. Note that a value of "N" does not imply a haircut is not applicable, only that the haircut (if any) is not reflected in the stated valuation.

fields.name: regulatorytradeid
fields.description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

fields.name: regulatorytradeidevent
fields.description: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

fields.name: regulatorytradeidsource
fields.description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

fields.name: regulatorytradeidtype
fields.description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in RegulatoryTradeID(1903).

fields.name: noregulatorytradeids
fields.description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

fields.name: noallocregulatorytradeids
fields.description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

fields.name: allocregulatorytradeid
fields.description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

fields.name: allocregulatorytradeidsource
fields.description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

fields.name: allocregulatorytradeidevent
fields.description: Identifies the event which caused the origination of the identifier in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2(Clearing).

fields.name: allocregulatorytradeidtype
fields.description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

fields.name: numofcompetitors
fields.description: The number of competing Respondents (e.g. dealers) to receive a quote request (either via the QuoteRequest(35=R) or via other means).

fields.name: responsetime
fields.description: The time by which a meaningful response should arrive back (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT").

fields.name: quotedisplaytime
fields.description: Time by which the quote will be displayed.

fields.name: exposuredurationunit
fields.description: Time unit in which the ExposureDuration(1629) is expressed.

fields.name: coverprice
fields.description: The best quoted price received among those not traded.

fields.name: noclearingaccounttypes
fields.description: Number of clearing account type entries.

fields.name: nopricemovements
fields.description: Number of price movement entries.

fields.name: nopricemovementvalues
fields.description: Number of price movement value entries.

fields.name: pricemovementvalue
fields.description: Value at specific price movement point.

fields.name: pricemovementpoint
fields.description: Price movement point up (positive integer) or down (negative integer) relative to the underlying price of the instrument.

fields.name: pricemovementtype
fields.description: Describes the format of the PriceMovementValue(1921).

fields.name: clearingintention
fields.description: Specifies the party's or parties' intention to clear the trade.

fields.name: tradeclearinginstruction
fields.description: Specifies the eligibility of this trade for clearing and central counterparty processing.

fields.name: backloadedtradeindicator
fields.description: Indicates that the trade being reported occurred in the past and is still in effect or active.

fields.name: confirmationmethod
fields.description: Specifies how a trade was confirmed.

fields.name: mandatoryclearingindicator
fields.description: An indication that the trade is flagged for mandatory clearing.

fields.name: mixedswapindicator
fields.description: An indication that the trade is a mixed swap.

fields.name: offmarketpriceindicator
fields.description: An indication that the price is off-market.

fields.name: verificationmethod
fields.description: Indication of how a trade was verified.

fields.name: clearingrequirementexception
fields.description: Specifies whether a party to a swap is using an exception to a clearing requirement. In the US, one such clearing requirement is CFTC's rule pursuant to CEA Section 2(h)(1).

fields.name: irsdirection
fields.description: Used to specify whether the principal is paying or receiving the fixed rate in an interest rate swap.

fields.name: regulatoryreporttype
fields.description: Type of regulatory report.

fields.name: voluntaryregulatoryreport
fields.description: Used in conjunction with RegulatoryReportType(1934) to indicate whether the trade report is a voluntary regulatory report. If not specified, the default for a regulatory report is "N".

fields.name: tradecollateralization
fields.description: Specifies how the trade is collateralized.

fields.name: tradecontinuation
fields.description: Specifies the post-execution trade continuation or lifecycle event. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

fields.name: assetclass
fields.description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

fields.name: assetsubclass
fields.description: The subcategory description of the asset class.

fields.name: assettype
fields.description: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in AssetSubClass(1939). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

fields.name: swapclass
fields.description: The classification or type of swap. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

fields.name: nthtodefault
fields.description: The Nth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. If specified without MthToDefault(1943) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If MthToDefault(1943) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

fields.name: mthtodefault
fields.description: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When NthToDefault(1942) and MthToDefault(1943) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

fields.name: settledentitymatrixsource
fields.description: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

fields.name: settledentitymatrixpublicationdate
fields.description: The publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. If not specified, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

fields.name: coupontype
fields.description: Coupon type of the bond.

fields.name: totalissuedamount
fields.description: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued securities.

fields.name: couponfrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

fields.name: couponfrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

fields.name: coupondaycount
fields.description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security. Absence of this field for a bond or an interest bearing security transaction implies a "flat" trade, i.e. no accrued interest determined at time of the transaction.

fields.name: convertiblebondequityid
fields.description: Identifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted to.

fields.name: convertiblebondequityidsource
fields.description: Identifies class or source of the ConvertibleBondEquityID(1951) value.

fields.name: contractpricerefmonth
fields.description: Reference month if there is no applicable MaturityMonthYear(200) value for the contract or security.

fields.name: lienseniority
fields.description: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

fields.name: loanfacility
fields.description: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

fields.name: referenceentitytype
fields.description: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.

fields.name: indexseries
fields.description: The series identifier of a credit default swap index.

fields.name: indexannexversion
fields.description: The version of a credit default swap index annex.

fields.name: indexannexdate
fields.description: The date of a credit default swap index series annex.

fields.name: indexannexsource
fields.description: The source of a credit default swap series annex.

fields.name: agreementversion
fields.description: The version of the master agreement

fields.name: masterconfirmationdesc
fields.description: The type of master confirmation executed between the parties. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-type for values.

fields.name: masterconfirmationdate
fields.description: Alternative to broker confirmation. The date of the confirmation executed between the parties and intended to govern all relevant transactions between those parties.

fields.name: masterconfirmationannexdesc
fields.description: The type of master confirmation annex executed between the parties. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-annex-type for values.

fields.name: masterconfirmationannexdate
fields.description: The date that an annex to the master confirmation was executed between the parties.

fields.name: brokerconfirmationdesc
fields.description: Describes the type of broker confirmation executed between the parites. Can be used as an alterative to MasterConfirmationDesc(1962). See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/broker-confirmation-type for values.

fields.name: creditsupportagreementdesc
fields.description: The type of ISDA Credit Support Agreement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-support-agreement-type for values.

fields.name: creditsupportagreementdate
fields.description: The date of the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties and intended to govern collateral arrangements for all OTC derivatives transactions between those parties.

fields.name: creditsupportagreementid
fields.description: A common reference or unique identifier to identify the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties.

fields.name: governinglaw
fields.description: Identification of the law governing the transaction. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/governing-law for values.

fields.name: nosideregulatorytradeids
fields.description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

fields.name: sideregulatorytradeid
fields.description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organziations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifier (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

fields.name: sideregulatorytradeidsource
fields.description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

fields.name: sideregulatorytradeidevent
fields.description: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

fields.name: sideregulatorytradeidtype

This is used by systems or trading platforms in conjunction with TradeID(1003) to uniquely identify the version of a trade or contract. If used the conditions for a change of version are subject to bilateral agreement. It is recommended to change the version only for significant updates to the business entity rather than for minor changes to trade details or systematic distribution of reports. Examples where the version would change are trade quantity modification, customer account assignment or trade novation.

fields.name: remunerationindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the trade price was adjusted for compensation (i.e. includes a mark-up, mark-down or commission) in the price paid.

fields.name: legtotaltradeqty
fields.description: Expresses the total quantity traded over the life of the contract when LegLastQty(1418) is to be repeated periodically over the term of the contract. The value is the product of LegLastQty(1418) and LegTradingUnitPeriodMultiplier(2353).

fields.name: leglastmultipliedqty
fields.description: Expresses the quantity bought/sold when LastQty is expressed in contracts. Used in addition to LegLastQty(1418), it is the product of LegLastQty(1418) and LegContractMultiplier(614).

fields.name: legtotalgrosstradeamt
fields.description: Expresses the full total monetary value of the traded contract. The value is the product of LegLastPx(637) and LegTotalTradeQty(2357) or LegTotalTradeMultipliedQty(2360), if priced in units instead of contracts.

fields.name: legtotaltrademultipliedqty
fields.description: Expresses the total trade quantity in units where LegContractMultiplier(614) is not 1. The value is the product of LegTotalTradeQty(2357) and LegContractMultiplier(614).

fields.name: compressiongroupid
fields.description: Use to identify a netting or compression group where trades in the group were netted or compressed. This includes both terminating trades and any remnant trades that result from the operation.

fields.name: selfmatchpreventionid
fields.description: Identifies an order or trade that should not be matched to an opposite order or trade if both buy and sell orders for the same asset contain the same SelfMatchPreventionID(2362) and submitted by the same firm.

fields.name: underlyingtradingunitperiodmultiplier

fields.name: posreportaction

fields.name: settlpricefxratecalc

fields.name: totaltradeqty
fields.description: Expresses the total quantity traded over the life of the contract when LastQty(32) is repeated periodically over the term of the contract. The value is the product of LastQty(32) and TradingUnitPeriodMultiplier(2353).

fields.name: lastmultipliedqty
fields.description: Expresses the quantity bought or sold when LastQty(32) is expressed in number of contracts. Used in addition to LastQty(32). It is the product of LastQty(32) and ContractMultiplier(231).

fields.name: totalgrosstradeamt
fields.description: Expresses the full total monetary value of the traded contract. The value is the product of LastPx(31) and TotalTradeQty(2367) or TotalTradeMultipliedQty(2370), if priced in units instead of contracts.

fields.name: totaltrademultipliedqty
fields.description: Expresses the total trade quantity in units where ContractMultiplier(231) is not 1. The value is the product of TotalTradeQty(2367) and ContractMultiplier(231).

fields.name: nomiscfeesubtypes
fields.description: Specifies the number of miscellaneous fee sub-types.

fields.name: miscfeesubtype
fields.description: Used to provide more granular fee types related to a value of MiscFeeType(139). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/misc-fee-sub-types for code list of applicable fees. Other fee sub-types may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

fields.name: miscfeesubtypeamt
fields.description: The amount of the specified MiscFeeSubType(2634).

fields.name: miscfeesubtypedesc
fields.description: Can be used to provide an optional textual description of the fee sub-type.

fields.name: encodedmiscfeesubtypedesclen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2638) field.

fields.name: encodedmiscfeesubtypedesc
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2636) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2636) field.

fields.name: nocommissions
fields.description: Number of commissions in the repeating group.

fields.name: commissionamount
fields.description: The commission amount.

fields.name: commissionamounttype
fields.description: Indicates what type of commission is being expressed in CommissionAmount(2640).

fields.name: commissionbasis
fields.description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

fields.name: commissioncurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency denomination of the commission amount if different from the trade's currency.

fields.name: commissionunitofmeasure
fields.description: The commission rate unit of measure.

fields.name: commissionunitofmeasurecurrency
fields.description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when CommissionUnitOfMeasure(2644) = Ccy (Amount of currency).

fields.name: commissionrate
fields.description: The commission rate when CommissionAmount(2640) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". If the rate is a percentage or expressed in basis points, use the decimalized form, e.g. "0.05" for a 5% commission or "0.005" for 50 basis points.

fields.name: commissionsharedindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the amount in CommissionAmount(2640) is to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement.

fields.name: commissionamountshared
fields.description: Commission amount to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement. If specified, this amount should not exceed the amount in CommissionAmount(2640).

fields.name: commissionlegrefid
fields.description: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

fields.name: commissiondesc
fields.description: Description of the commission.

fields.name: encodedcommissiondesclen
fields.description: Byte length of the encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedCommissionDesc(2652) field.

fields.name: encodedcommissiondesc
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the CommissionDesc(2650) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the CommissionDesc(2650) field.

fields.name: noalloccommissions
fields.description: Number of commissions in the repeating group.

fields.name: alloccommissionamount
fields.description: The commission amount.

fields.name: alloccommissionamounttype
fields.description: Indicates what type of commission is being expressed in AllocCommissionAmount(2654).

fields.name: alloccommissionbasis
fields.description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

fields.name: alloccommissioncurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency denomination of the commission amount if different from the trade's currency.

fields.name: alloccommissionunitofmeasure
fields.description: The commission rate unit of measure.

fields.name: alloccommissionunitofmeasurecurrency
fields.description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when AllocCommissionUnitOfMeasure(2658) = Ccy (Currency).

fields.name: alloccommissionrate
fields.description: The commission rate when AllocCommissionAmount(2654) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". If the rate is a percentage or expressed in basis points, use the decimalized form, e.g. "0.05" for a 5% commission or "0.005" for 50 basis points.

fields.name: alloccommissionsharedindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the amount in AllocCommissionAmount(2654) is to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement.

fields.name: alloccommissionamountshared
fields.description: Commission amount to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement. If specified, this amount should not exceed the amount in AllocCommissionAmount(2654).

fields.name: alloccommissionlegrefid
fields.description: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

fields.name: alloccommissiondesc
fields.description: Description of the commission.

fields.name: encodedalloccommissiondesclen
fields.description: Byte length of the encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAllocCommissionDesc(2666) field.

fields.name: encodedalloccommissiondesc
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AllocCommissionDesc(2664) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AllocCommissionDesc(2664) field.

fields.name: algorithmictradeindicator
fields.description: Indicates that the order or trade originates from a computer program or algorithm requiring little-to-no human intervention.

fields.name: notrdregpublications
fields.description: Number of regulatory publication rules in repeating group.

fields.name: trdregpublicationtype
fields.description: Specifies the type of regulatory trade publication.

fields.name: trdregpublicationreason
fields.description: Additional reason for trade publication type specified in TrdRegPublicationType(2669).

fields.name: sidetradereportingindicator
fields.description: Used between parties to convey trade reporting status.

fields.name: crossrequestid
fields.description: Unique message identifier for a cross request as assigned by the submitter of the request.

fields.name: fillmatchid
fields.description: Identifier assigned by a matching system to a match event containing multiple executions.

fields.name: fillmatchsubid
fields.description: Identifier assigned by a matching system to a price level (e.g. match step, clip) within a match event containing multiple executions.

fields.name: massactionreason
fields.description: Reason for submission of mass action.

fields.name: maximumpricedeviation
fields.description: Maximum deviation, in percentage terms, of an execution price from a reference price, e.g. the initial price of a match event.

fields.name: notaffectedreason
fields.description: Reason for order being unaffected by mass action even though it belongs to the orders covered by MassActionScope(1374).

fields.name: totalnotaffectedorders
fields.description: Total number of orders unaffected by either the OrderMassActionRequest(35=CA) or OrderMassCancelRequest(35=Q).

fields.name: orderownershipindicator
fields.description: Change of ownership of an order to a specific party.

fields.name: legaccount
fields.description: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

fields.name: inthemoneycondition
fields.description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition.

fields.name: leginthemoneycondition
fields.description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition in general terms.

fields.name: underlyinginthemoneycondition
fields.description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition in general terms.

fields.name: derivativeinthemoneycondition
fields.description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition in general terms.

fields.name: contraryinstructioneligibilityindicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of InTheMoneyCondition(2681). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

fields.name: legcontraryinstructioneligibilityindicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of LegInTheMoneyCondition(2682). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

fields.name: underlyingcontraryinstructioneligibilityindicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of UnderlyingInTheMoneyCondition(2683). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

fields.name: derivativecontraryinstructioneligibilityindicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of DerivativeInTheMoneyCondition(2684). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

fields.name: collateralmarketprice
fields.description: Market price of the collateral, either from market sources or pre-agreed by the counterparties.

fields.name: collateralpercentoverage
fields.description: Percentage of over-collateralization particularly when CollateralAmountType(2632) = 4 (Additional collateral value)

fields.name: nosidecollateralamounts
fields.description: Number of side collateral amount entries.

fields.name: sidecollateralamountmarketid
fields.description: Market associated with the collateral amount.

fields.name: sidecollateralamountmarketsegmentid
fields.description: Market segment associated with the collateral amount.

fields.name: sidecollateralamounttype
fields.description: The type of value in CurrentCollateralAmount(1704).

fields.name: sidecollateralcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency of the collateral; optional, defaults to settlement currency if not specified.

fields.name: sidecollateralfxrate
fields.description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the SideCurrentCollateralAmount(2702) from the SideCollateralCurrency(2695) and the Currency(15).

fields.name: sidecollateralfxratecalc
fields.description: Specifies whether or not SideCollateralFXRate(2696) should be multiplied or divided.

fields.name: sidecollateralmarketprice
fields.description: Market price of the collateral, either from market sources or pre-agreed by the counterparties.

fields.name: sidecollateralpercentoverage
fields.description: Percentage of over-collateralization particularly when SideCollateralAmountType(2694) = 4 (Additional collateral value).

fields.name: sidecollateralportfolioid
fields.description: Identifier of the collateral portfolio when reporting on a portfolio basis.

fields.name: sidecollateraltype
fields.description: Type of collateral on deposit being reported.

fields.name: sidecurrentcollateralamount
fields.description: Currency value currently attributed to the collateral.

fields.name: sidehaircutindicator
fields.description: Indicates, if "Y", that a stated valuation includes a haircut, e.g. that the stated value reflects the subtraction of the haircut. Note that a value of "N" does not imply a haircut is not applicable, only that the haircut (if any) is not reflected in the stated valuation.

fields.name: exdestinationtype
fields.description: Identifies the type of execution destination for the order.

fields.name: marketcondition
fields.description: Market condition. In the context of ESMA RTS 8 it is important that trading venues communicate the condition of the market, particularly "stressed" and "exceptional", in order to provide incentives for firms contributing to liquidity.

fields.name: noquoteattributes
fields.description: Number of quote attributes entries.

fields.name: quoteattributetype
fields.description: The type of attribute for the quote.

fields.name: quoteattributevalue
fields.description: The value associated with the quote attribute type specified in QuoteAttributeType(2707).

fields.name: nopricequalifiers
fields.description: Number of price qualifiers in the repeating group.

fields.name: pricequalifier
fields.description: Qualifier for price. May be used when the price needs to be explicitly qualified.

fields.name: mdvaluetier
fields.description: Describes the reporting ranges for executed transactions.

fields.name: miscfeequalifier
fields.description: Identifies whether the current entry contributes to the trade or transaction economics, i.e. affects NetMoney(118).

fields.name: miscfeedesc
fields.description: Can be used to provide a textual description of the fee type.

fields.name: financialinstrumentfullname
fields.description: The full normative name of the financial instrument.

fields.name: encodedfinancialinstrumentfullnamelen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedFinancialInstrumentFullName(2716) field.

fields.name: encodedfinancialinstrumentfullname
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the FinancialInstrumentFullName(2714) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the FinancialInstrumentFullName(2714) field.

fields.name: legfinancialinstrumentfullname
fields.description: The full normative name of the multileg's financial instrument.

fields.name: encodedlegfinancialinstrumentfullnamelen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) individual multileg instrument's EncodedLegFinancialInstrumentFullName(2719).

fields.name: encodedlegfinancialinstrumentfullname
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegFinancialInstrumentFullName(2717) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegFinancialInstrumentFullName(2717) field.

fields.name: underlyingfinancialinstrumentfullname
fields.description: The full normative name of the underlying financial instrument.

fields.name: encodedunderlyingfinancialinstrumentfullnamelen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) underlying instrument's EncodedUnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName(2722).

fields.name: encodedunderlyingfinancialinstrumentfullname
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName(2720) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName(2720) field.

fields.name: underlyingindexcurveunit
fields.description: Curve time unit associated with the underlying index.

fields.name: underlyingindexcurveperiod
fields.description: Curve time multiplier for the underlying index.

fields.name: commissionamountsubtype
fields.description: Further sub classification of the CommissionAmountType(2641).

fields.name: alloccommissionamountsubtype
fields.description: Further sub classification of the AllocCommissionAmountType(2655).

fields.name: alloclegrefid
fields.description: Unique identifier for a specific leg (uniqueness not defined as part of the FIX specification). AllocLegRefID(2727) references the value from LegID(1788) in the current multileg order or trade message specifying to which leg the allocation instance applies.

fields.name: floatingrateindexcurveperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index identified in FloatingRateIndexID(2731).

fields.name: floatingrateindexcurvespread
fields.description: Spread from the floating rate index.

fields.name: floatingrateindexcurveunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the floating rate index identified in FloatingRateIndexID(2731).

fields.name: floatingrateindexid
fields.description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

fields.name: floatingrateindexidsource
fields.description: Source for the floating rate index identified in FloatingRateIndexID(2731).

fields.name: indexrollmonth
fields.description: Month identified in the index roll.

fields.name: noindexrollmonths
fields.description: Number of instances of the index roll month.

fields.name: assetsubtype
fields.description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in AssetType(1940). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/assetsubtype for code list of applicable values.

fields.name: commodityfinalpricetype
fields.description: Final price type of the commodity as specified by the trading venue.

fields.name: financialinstrumentshortname
fields.description: Short name of the financial instrument. Uses ISO 18774 (FINS) values.

fields.name: nextindexrolldate
fields.description: Next index roll date.

fields.name: legassetsubtype
fields.description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in LegAssetType(2069). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/assetsubtype for code list of applicable values.

fields.name: legfinancialinstrumentshortname
fields.description: Short name of the financial instrument. Uses ISO 18774 (FISN) values.

fields.name: secondaryassetsubtype
fields.description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in SecondaryAssetType(1979). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/assetsubtype for code list of applicable values.

fields.name: underlyingfinancialinstrumentshortname
fields.description: Short name of the financial instrument. Uses ISO 18774 (FINS) values.

fields.name: legsecondaryassetsubtype
fields.description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in LegSecondaryAssetType(2079). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/assetsubtype for code list of applicable values.

fields.name: underlyingassetsubtype
fields.description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingAssetType(2015). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/assetsubtype for code list of applicable values.

fields.name: underlyingsecondaryassetsubtype
fields.description: May be used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingSecondaryAssetType(2083). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/assetsubtype for code list of applicable values.

fields.name: noreferencedatadates
fields.description: Number of instances of reference data dates.

fields.name: referencedatadate
fields.description: Reference data entry's date-time of the type specified in ReferenceDataDateType(2748).

fields.name: referencedatadatetype
fields.description: Reference data entry's date-time type.

fields.name: executiontimestamp
fields.description: Time of the individual execution.

fields.name: reportingpx
fields.description: Represents the reportable price on fill when an instance of the Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 73 (Execution Venue) is present to prevent having to compute running totals.

fields.name: reportingqty
fields.description: Represents the reportable quantity on fill when an instance of the Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 73 (Execution Venue) is present to prevent having to compute running totals.

fields.name: deliveryrouteorcharter
fields.description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight contracts.

fields.name: returntrigger
fields.description: Indicates the type of return or payout trigger for the swap or forward.

fields.name: legdeliveryrouteorcharter
fields.description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight contracts.

fields.name: legreturntrigger
fields.description: Indicates the type of return or payout trigger for the swap or forward.

fields.name: underlyingdeliveryrouteorcharter
fields.description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight contracts.

fields.name: underlyingreturntrigger
fields.description: Indicates the type of return or payout trigger for the swap or forward.

fields.name: allocrequestid
fields.description: Unique identifier for the request message.

fields.name: groupamount
fields.description: Indicates the total notional units or amount of an allocation group. Includes any allocated units or amount.

fields.name: groupremainingamount
fields.description: Indicates the remaining notional units or amount of an allocation group that has not yet been allocated.

fields.name: allocgroupamount
fields.description: Indicates the notional units or amount being allocated.

fields.name: pricemarkup
fields.description: Price offset of the markup denominated in the price type of the trade.

fields.name: averagepricetype
fields.description: The average pricing model used for block trades.

fields.name: averagepricestarttime
fields.description: Start of the time period during which price averaging occurred.

fields.name: averagepriceendtime
fields.description: End of the time period during which price averaging occurred.

fields.name: orderpercentoftotalvolume
fields.description: For Percent-of-volume (POV) average pricing this is the target percentage this order quantity represents of the total trading volume of an instrument during the specified time period. This provides the data needed to ensure that the average price is fair based on the total sum of grouped POV trades.

fields.name: allocgroupstatus
fields.description: Status of the trade give-up relative to the group identified in AllocGroupID(1730).

fields.name: allocrequeststatus
fields.description: Status of the AllocationInstructionAlertRequest(35=DU).

fields.name: allocavgpxindicator
fields.description: Average pricing indicator at the allocation level.

fields.name: allocavgpxgroupid
fields.description: Used by submitting firm to group trades being sub-allocated into an average price group. The trades in the average price group will be used to calculate an average price for the group.

fields.name: previousallocgroupid
fields.description: When reporting a group change by the central counterparty to allocations of trades for the same instrument traded at the same price this identifies the previous group identifier.

fields.name: nomatchexceptions
fields.description: Number of match exceptions in the repeating group.

fields.name: matchexceptiontype
fields.description: Type of matching exception.

fields.name: matchexceptionelementtype
fields.description: Identifies the data point used in the matching operation which resulted in an exception.

fields.name: matchexceptionelementname
fields.description: The matching exception data point name, for example: "Trade currency". This may be used for display purposes, providing a corresponding description for the value in MatchExceptionElementType(2774).

fields.name: matchexceptionallocvalue
fields.description: The allocating party's data value used in the match operation.

fields.name: matchexceptionconfirmvalue
fields.description: The confirming party's data value used in the match operation.

fields.name: matchexceptiontolerancevalue
fields.description: The data element's tolerance value. Omitted if no tolerance is allowed or not applicable.

fields.name: matchexceptiontolerancevaluetype
fields.description: The type of value in MatchExceptionToleranceValue(2778). Omitted if no tolerance is allowed or not applicable.

fields.name: matchexceptiontext
fields.description: Description of the exception.

fields.name: nomatchingdatapoints
fields.description: Number of matching data points in the repeating group.

fields.name: matchingdatapointindicator
fields.description: Data point's matching type.

fields.name: matchingdatapointvalue
fields.description: Value of the matching data point.

fields.name: matchingdatapointtype
fields.description: Identifies the data point used in the matching operation.

fields.name: matchingdatapointname
fields.description: The matching data point name, for example: "Trade currency". This may be used for display purposes, providing a corresponding description for the value in MatchingDataPointType(2784).

fields.name: tradeaggregationrequestid
fields.description: The message identifier for the trade aggregation request.

fields.name: tradeaggregationrequestrefid
fields.description: Reference identifier to a previously sent trade aggregation message being cancelled or replaced.

fields.name: tradeaggregationtranstype
fields.description: Identifies the trade aggregation transaction type.

fields.name: aggregatedqty
fields.description: Total quantity of orders or fills quantity aggregated.

fields.name: tradeaggregationrequeststatus
fields.description: Status of the trade aggregation request.

fields.name: tradeaggregationrejectreason
fields.description: Reason for trade aggregation request being rejected.

fields.name: tradeaggregationreportid
fields.description: Unique identifier for the TradeAggregationReport(35=DX).

fields.name: avgspotrate
fields.description: The average FX spot rate.

fields.name: avgforwardpoints
fields.description: The average forward points. May be a negative value.

fields.name: offshoreindicator
fields.description: Indicates the type of the currency rate being used. This is relevant for currencies that have offshore rate that different from onshore rate.

fields.name: fxbenchmarkratefix
fields.description: Specifies the foreign exchange benchmark rate fixing to be used in valuing the transaction. For example "London 4 p.m." or "Tokyo 3 p.m."

fields.name: encodedmatchexceptiontextlen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMatchExceptionText(2798) field.

fields.name: encodedmatchexceptiontext
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MatchExceptionText(2780) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field.

fields.name: payreportid
fields.description: Unique ID of the PayManagementReport(35=EA) message.

fields.name: paydisputereason
fields.description: Used to provide the reason for disputing a request or report.

fields.name: encodedreplacetext
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ReplaceText(2805) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ReplaceText(2805) field.

fields.name: encodedreplacetextlen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedReplaceText(2801) field.

fields.name: payreportrefid
fields.description: Reference identifier of the PayManagementReport(35=EA). To be used with PayReportTransType(2804)=1 (Replace).

fields.name: payreporttranstype
fields.description: Identifies the message transaction type.

fields.name: replacetext
fields.description: Identifies the reason for amendment.

fields.name: payreportstatus
fields.description: Identifies status of the payment report.

fields.name: canceltext
fields.description: Identifies the reason for cancelation.

fields.name: encodedcanceltext
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the CancelText(2807) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the CancelText(2807) field.

fields.name: encodedcanceltextlen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedCancelText(2808) field.

fields.name: payrequestrefid
fields.description: Reference identifier of the PayManagementRequest(35=DY). To be used with PayRequestTransType(2811)=1 (Cancel).

fields.name: payrequesttranstype
fields.description: Identifies the message transaction type.

fields.name: payrequestid
fields.description: Unique ID of the PayManagementRequest(35=DY) message.

fields.name: payrequeststatus
fields.description: Identifies status of the request being responded to.

fields.name: encodedposttradepaymentdesc
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the PostTradePaymentDesc(2820) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the PostTradePaymentDesc(2820) field.

fields.name: encodedposttradepaymentdesclen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedPostTradePaymentDesc(2814) field.

fields.name: posttradepaymentaccount
fields.description: The cash account on the books of the receiver of the request or the sender of the report to be debited or credited.

fields.name: posttradepaymentamount
fields.description: The payment amount for the specified PostTradePaymentType(2824).

fields.name: posttradepaymentcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency in which PostTradePaymentAmount(2817) is denominated.

fields.name: posttradepaymentdebitorcredit
fields.description: Payment side of this individual payment from the requesting firm's perspective.

fields.name: posttradepaymentdesc
fields.description: A short descriptive name given to the payment, e.g. Premium, Upfront, etc. The description may be used as reference.

fields.name: posttradepaymentid
fields.description: The identifier for the individual payment.

fields.name: posttradepaymentlinkid
fields.description: Used to link a group of payments together, e.g. cross-currency payments associated with a swap.

fields.name: posttradepaymentstatus
fields.description: Used to indicate the status of a post-trade payment.

fields.name: posttradepaymenttype
fields.description: Type of post-trade payment.

fields.name: posttradepaymentcalculationdate
fields.description: The (actual) date the periodic payments calculations are made.

fields.name: posttradepaymentvaluedate
fields.description: The adjusted (for holidays and other non-business days) payment date on which the payment is expected to settle.

fields.name: posttradepaymentfinalvaluedate
fields.description: The actual or final payment date on which the payment was made.

fields.name: currentdisplayprice
fields.description: Price at which the order is currently displayed to the market. Can be used on order messages, e.g. NewOrderSingle(35=D), to provide the current displayed price of a parent order when splitting it into smaller child orders.

fields.name: duplicateclordidindicator
fields.description: Used to indicate that a ClOrdID(11) value is an intentional duplicate of a previously sent value. Allows to avoid the rejection of an order with OrdRejReason(103) = 6 (Duplicate Order).

fields.name: eventinitiatortype
fields.description: Indicates the type of entity who initiated an event, e.g. modification or cancellation of an order or quote.

fields.name: nbboentrytype
fields.description: Type of NBBO information.

fields.name: nbboprice
fields.description: Price related to NBBO. NBBOEntryType(2831) may be used to indicate entry type, e.g. bid or offer.

fields.name: nbboqty
fields.description: Quantity related to NBBO. NBBOEntryType(2831) may be used to indicte entry type, e.g. bid or offer.

fields.name: nbbosource
fields.description: Source of NBBO information.

fields.name: orderoriginationfirmid
fields.description: Identifier for the original owner of an order as part of the RelatedOrderGrp component. Use the Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 13 (Order Origination Firm) to identify the original owner of an individual order.

fields.name: relatedordertime
fields.description: Timestamp for the assignment of a (unique) identifier to an order.

fields.name: singlequoteindicator
fields.description: Used to indicate whether the quoting system allows only one quote to be active at a time for the quote issuer or market maker.

fields.name: currentworkingprice
fields.description: Current working price of the order relative to the state of the order.

fields.name: trdregtimestampmanualindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether a given timestamp was manually captured.

fields.name: collateralreinvestmentrate
fields.description: Interest rate received for collateral reinvestment.

fields.name: underlyingrefid
fields.description: Identifies the underlying instrument the entity applies to by referencing the underlying instrument's UnderlyingID(2874).

fields.name: collateralreinvestmentamount
