fields.description: Type of provisions.

fields.name: legprovisiondateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

fields.name: legprovisiondatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.name: legprovisiondatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisiondateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted date of the provision.

fields.name: legprovisiondatetenorperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the leg provision's tenor period.

fields.name: legprovisiondatetenorunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the leg provision's tenor period.

fields.name: legprovisioncalculationagent
fields.description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in LegProvisionCalculationAgent(40456) or in the ProvisionParties component.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionsinglepartybuyerside
fields.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionsinglepartysellerside
fields.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisestyle
fields.description: The instrument provision option exercise style.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisemultiplenotional
fields.description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseminimumnotional
fields.description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisemaximumnotional
fields.description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionminimumnumber
fields.description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionmaximumnumber
fields.description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseconfirmation
fields.description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlmethod
fields.description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlcurrency2
fields.description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlquotetype
fields.description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlquotesource
fields.description: Identifies the source of quote information.

fields.name: businesscenter
fields.description: A business center whose calendar is used for date adjustment, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisiontext
fields.description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

fields.name: nolegprovisioncashsettlpaymentdates
fields.description: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdate
fields.description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40521).

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseearliestdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseearliestdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisefrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisefrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisestartdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisestartdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisestartdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisestartdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisestartdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisestartdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseperiodskip
fields.description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseboundsfirstdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseboundslastdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseearliesttime
fields.description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciseearliesttimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciselatesttime
fields.description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexerciselatesttimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nolegprovisionoptionexercisefixeddates
fields.description: Number of provision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisefixeddate
fields.description: A predetermined option exercise date unadjusted or adjusted depending on LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(40497).

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexercisefixeddatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationtime
fields.description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionexpirationtimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option relevant underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

fields.name: legprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdaterangefirst
fields.description: The first date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlpaymentdaterangelast
fields.description: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluetime
fields.description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluetimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluedatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluedatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluedaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluedateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluedateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluedateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

fields.name: legprovisioncashsettlvaluedateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

fields.name: nolegprovisionpartyids
fields.description: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

fields.name: legprovisionpartyid
fields.description: The party identifier/code for the payment settlement party.

fields.name: legprovisionpartyidsource
fields.description: Identifies the class or source of LegProvisionPartyID(40534).

fields.name: legprovisionpartyrole
fields.description: Identifies the type or role of LegProvisionPartyID(40534) specified.

fields.name: nolegprovisionpartysubids
fields.description: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

fields.name: legprovisionpartysubid
fields.description: Party sub-identifier, if applicable, for LegProvisionPartyRole(40536).

fields.name: legprovisionpartysubidtype
fields.description: The type of LegProvisionPartySubID(40538) value.

fields.name: nounderlyingstreams
fields.description: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingstreamtype
fields.description: Type of swap stream.

fields.name: underlyingstreamdesc
fields.description: A short descriptive name given to payment stream. Eg. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as a reference.

fields.name: underlyingstreampayside
fields.description: The side of the party paying the stream.

fields.name: underlyingstreamreceiveside
fields.description: The side of the party receiving the stream.

fields.name: underlyingstreamnotional
fields.description: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. Use SwapSchedule for steps.

fields.name: underlyingstreamcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingStreamNotional(40545) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingstreamtext
fields.description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted termination date.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

fields.name: underlyingstreamterminationdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted termination date.

fields.name: underlyingstreamcalculationperiodbusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingstreamcalculationperiodbusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the calculation periods, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingstreamfirstperiodstartdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

fields.name: underlyingstreamfirstperiodstartdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingstreamfirstperiodstartdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingstreamfirstperiodstartdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

fields.name: underlyingstreamfirstregularperiodstartdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

fields.name: underlyingstreamfirstcompoundingperiodenddateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

fields.name: underlyingstreamlastregularperiodenddateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

fields.name: underlyingstreamcalculationfrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

fields.name: underlyingstreamcalculationfrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

fields.name: underlyingstreamcalculationrollconvention
fields.description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamtype
fields.description: Identifies the type of payment stream applicable to the swap stream associated with the underlying instrument.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreammarketrate
fields.description: Used only for credit index trade. This contains the credit spread ("fair value") at which the trade was executed. The market rate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. This is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamdelayindicator
fields.description: Applicable to credit default swaps on mortgage backed securities to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed amount.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamsettlcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency that the stream settles in (to support swaps that settle in a currency different from the notional currency). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamdaycount
fields.description: The day count convention used in the payment stream calculations.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamaccrualdays
fields.description: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamdiscounttype
fields.description: The method of calculating discounted payment amounts

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamdiscountrate
fields.description: Discount rate. The rate is expressed in decimal, e.g. 5% is expressed as 0.05.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamdiscountratedaycount
fields.description: The day count convention applied to the UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountRate(40575).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingmethod
fields.description: Compounding Method.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialprincipalexchangeindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminterimprincipalexchangeindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalprincipalexchangeindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentfrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of payments.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentfrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of payments.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentrollconvention
fields.description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfirstpaymentdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first payment date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlastregularpaymentdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted last regular payment date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when payment dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative payment date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreampaymentdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative payment date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamresetdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the reset dates are relative to an anchor date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamresetdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's reset date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamresetdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's reset date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamresetfrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for frequency of resets.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamresetfrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with frequency of resets.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamresetweeklyrollconvention
fields.description: Used to specify the day of the week in which the reset occurs for payments that reset on a weekly basis.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialfixingdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the initial fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialfixingdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialfixingdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialfixingdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialfixingdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative initial fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialfixingdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative initial fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialfixingdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted initial fixing date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted fixing date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamratecutoffdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative rate cut-off date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamratecutoffdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative rate cut-off date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamratecutoffdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative rate cut-off date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamrate
fields.description: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment stream.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixedamount
fields.description: The underlying payment stream's fixed payment amount. In CDS an alternative to UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate(40615).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamrateoramountcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency in which UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixedAmount(40616) or UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate(40615) is denominated. Users ISO 4271 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfuturevaluenotional
fields.description: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfuturevaluedateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamrateindex
fields.description: The payment stream's floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamrateindexsource
fields.description: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamrateindexcurveunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the underlying instrument’s floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamrateindexcurveperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the underlying instrument’s floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamratemultiplier
fields.description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. A multiplier schedule is expressed as explicit multipliers and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in the calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamratespread
fields.description: Spread from floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamratespreadpositiontype
fields.description: Identifies a short or long spread value.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamratetreatment
fields.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcaprate
fields.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcapratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcapratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfloorrate
fields.description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfloorratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfloorratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminitialrate
fields.description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. An initial rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalrateroundingdirection
fields.description: Specifies the rounding direction.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalrateprecision
fields.description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamaveragingmethod
fields.description: When rate averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average calculation method is to be used.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnegativeratetreatment
fields.description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationlagperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determines the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationlagunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationlagdaytype
fields.description: The inflation lag period day type.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationinterpolationmethod
fields.description: The method used when calculating the Inflation Index Level from multiple points - the most common is Linear.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationindexsource
fields.description: The inflation index reference source.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationpublicationsource
fields.description: The current main publication source such as relevant web site or a government body.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationinitialindexlevel
fields.description: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminflationfallbackbondapplicable
fields.description: Indicates whether a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8, is applicable or not. If not specified, the default value is "Y" (True/Yes).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfradiscounting
fields.description: The method of Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) discounting, if any, that will apply.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablerefcurrency
fields.description: The non-deliverable settlement reference currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablefixingdatesbizdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablefixingdatesbusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablefixingdatesrelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the non-deliverable fixing dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablefixingdatesoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablefixingdatesoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablefixingdatesoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

fields.name: settlratefallbackreferencepage
fields.description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When SettlRateFallbackRateSource(40373) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

fields.name: nounderlyingnondeliverablefixingdates
fields.description: Number of Fixing dates in the repeating group

fields.name: underlyingnondeliverablefixingdate
fields.description: The non-deliverable fixing date unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDateType(40658).

fields.name: underlyingnondeliverablefixingdatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: nounderlyingsettlratefallbacks
fields.description: Number of settlement rate fallbacks in the repeating group

fields.name: underlyingsettlratepostponementmaximumdays
fields.description: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceding to this method.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnondeliverablesettlratesource
fields.description: Identifies the source of rate information.

fields.name: underlyingsettlratepostponementsurvey
fields.description: Indicates whether to request a settlement rate quote from the market.

fields.name: underlyingsettlratepostponementcalculationagent
fields.description: Used to identify the settlement rate postponement calculation agent.

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentschedules
fields.description: Number of swap schedules in the repeating group

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduletype
fields.description: Type of schedule.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulestubtype
fields.description: Indicates to which stub this schedule applies.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulestartdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted date on which the value is adjusted, or calculated if a future value notional for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)), or the start date of a cashflow payment.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleenddateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted end date of a cashflow payment.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulepayside
fields.description: The side of the party paying the step schedule.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulereceiveside
fields.description: The side of the party receiving the step schedule.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulenotional
fields.description: The notional value for this step, or amount of a cashflow payment.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulecurrency
fields.description: The currency for this step. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulerate
fields.description: The rate value for this step.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleratemultiplier
fields.description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleratespread
fields.description: The spread value for this step.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleratespreadpositiontype
fields.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleratetreatment
fields.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixedamount
fields.description: The explicit payment amount for this step.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixedcurrency
fields.description: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulestepfrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulestepfrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulestepoffsetvalue
fields.description: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulesteprate
fields.description: The percentage by which the notional changes on each step date. The percentage is either a percentage applied to the initial notional amount or the previous outstanding notional, depending on the value specified in UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo(40685). The percentage can be either positive or negative.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulestepoffsetrate
fields.description: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulesteprelativeto
fields.description: Specifies whether the UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRate(40683) or UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40682) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted fixing date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleweight
fields.description: Floating rate observation weight for cashflow payment.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdatebusinessdaycnvtn
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted fixing date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingtime
fields.description: The fixing time.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulefixingtimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Business center for determining fixing time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleinterimexchangepaymentdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the interim exchange payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleinterimexchangedatesbizdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleinterimexchangedatesbusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleinterimexchangedatesoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative interim exchange date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleinterimexchangedatesoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative interim exchange date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleinterimexchangedatesoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative interim exchange date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleinterimexchangedateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted interim exchange date.

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentscheduleratesources
fields.description: Number of rate sources in the repeating group

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleratesource
fields.description: Identifies the source of rate information.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentscheduleratesourcetype
fields.description: Rate source type.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentschedulereferencepage
fields.description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When RateSource(1446) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentstubs
fields.description: Number of stubs in the repeating group

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubtype
fields.description: Stub type.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstublength
fields.description: Optional indication whether stub is shorter or longer than the regular swap period.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubrate
fields.description: The agreed upon fixed rate for this stub.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubfixedamount
fields.description: A fixed payment amount for the stub.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubfixedcurrency
fields.description: The currency of the fixed payment amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubindex
fields.description: The stub floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubindexsource
fields.description: The source for the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubindexcurveperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubindexcurveunit

fields.name: nolegcashsettldealers
fields.description: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

fields.name: legcashsettldealer
fields.description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.

fields.name: nolegcashsettlterms
fields.description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

fields.name: legcashsettlcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlAmount(41357) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: legcassettlvaluationfirstbusinessdayoffset
fields.description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

fields.name: legcashsettlvaluationsubsequentbusinessdaysoffset
fields.description: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement.

fields.name: legcashsettlnumofvaluationdates
fields.description: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of applicable valuation dates.

fields.name: legcashsettlvaluationtime
fields.description: Time of valuation.

fields.name: legcashsettlbusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legcashsettlquotemethod
fields.description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

fields.name: legcashsettlquoteamount
fields.description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

fields.name: legcashsettlquotecurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlQuoteAmount(41352) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

fields.name: legcashsettlminimumquoteamount
fields.description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

fields.name: legcashsettlminimumquotecurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlQuoteMinimumAmount(41354) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

fields.name: legcashsettlbusinessdays
fields.description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.

fields.name: legcashsettlamount
fields.description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

fields.name: legcashsettlrecoveryfactor
fields.description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount calculated is (1 - LegCashSettlRecoveryFactor(41358)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

fields.name: legcashsettlfixedtermindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

fields.name: legcashsettlaccruedinterestindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in LegCashSettlAmount(41357).

fields.name: legcashsettlvaluationmethod
fields.description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

fields.name: legcashsettltermxid
fields.description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

fields.name: nolegcomplexeventaveragingobservations

fields.name: legcomplexeventcrediteventqualifier

fields.name: legcomplexeventperiodtype

fields.name: legcomplexeventbusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center for adjusting dates and times in the schedule or date-time group. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nolegcomplexeventratesources
fields.description: Number of rate sources in the repeating group.

fields.name: legcomplexeventratesource
fields.description: Identifies the source of rate information.

fields.name: legcomplexeventratesourcetype
fields.description: Indicates whether the rate source specified is a primary or secondary source.

fields.name: legcomplexeventreferencepage
fields.description: Identifies the reference page from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate is to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When LegComplexEventRateSource(41383) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option.

fields.name: legcomplexevenreferencepageheading
fields.description: Identifies the reference page heading from the rate source.

fields.name: nolegcomplexeventdatebusinesscenters

fields.name: legcomplexeventdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the event date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legcomplexeventdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted complex event date.

fields.name: legcomplexeventdaterelativeto

fields.name: legcomplexeventdateoffsetperiod

fields.name: legcomplexeventdateoffsetunit

fields.name: legcomplexeventdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative date offset.

fields.name: legcomplexeventdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the event date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.name: legcomplexeventdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted complex event date.

fields.name: legcomplexeventfixingtime
fields.description: The local market fixing time.

fields.name: legcomplexeventfixingtimebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center for determining the actual fixing times. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nolegcomplexeventcrediteventsources

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulenotionalcommodityfrequency
fields.description: The frequency of notional delivery.

fields.description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41417). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulepositivetolerance
fields.description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41417). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

fields.name: legdeliveryscheduletolerancetype

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulesettltimezone
fields.description: Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulesettlflowtype
fields.description: Specifies the delivery flow type.

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulesettlholidaysprocessinginstruction
fields.description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

fields.description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulesettltotalhours
fields.description: The sum of the total hours specified in the LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeGrp component.

fields.name: nolegdeliveryschedulesettltimes

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulesettlstart
fields.description: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41428).

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulesettlend
fields.description: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41428).

fields.name: legdeliveryschedulesettltimetype
fields.description: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtype
fields.description: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

fields.name: legdeliverystreampipeline

fields.description: The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product. For bullion, see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamdeliveryrestriction
fields.description: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamdeliverycontingency
fields.description: Specifies the electricity delivery contingency. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamdeliverycontingentpartyside
fields.description: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamdeliveratsourceindicator
fields.description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamriskapportionment
fields.description: Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/risk-apportionment for the details of the external code list.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtitletransferlocation
fields.description: Specifies the title transfer location.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtitletransfercondition
fields.description: Specifies the condition of title transfer.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamimporterofrecord
fields.description: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamnegativetolerance
fields.description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

fields.name: legdeliverystreampositivetolerance
fields.description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtoleranceunitofmeasure
fields.description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtolerancetype
fields.description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtoleranceoptionside
fields.description: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtotalpositivetolerance
fields.description: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtotalnegativetolerance
fields.description: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamnotionalconversionfactor
fields.description: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamtransportequipment
fields.description: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamelectingpartyside
fields.description: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period e.g. a swing or interruptible contract.

fields.name: nolegstreamassetattributes
fields.description: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

fields.name: legstreamassetattributetype
fields.description: Specifies the name of the attribute. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-attribute-type for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

fields.name: legstreamassetattributevalue
fields.description: Specifies the value of the attribute.

fields.name: legstreamassetattributelimit
fields.description: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

fields.name: nolegdeliverystreamcycles
fields.description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamcycledesc
fields.description: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

fields.name: encodedlegdeliverystreamcycledesclen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41459) field.

fields.name: encodedlegdeliverystreamcycledesc
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41457) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegLeg DeliveryStream(41457) field.

fields.name: nolegdeliverystreamcommoditysources
fields.description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

fields.name: legdeliverystreamcommoditysource
fields.description: The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionprovision
fields.description: The consequences of market disruption events.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackprovision
fields.description: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionmaximumdays
fields.description: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionmaterialitypercentage
fields.description: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionminimumfuturescontracts
fields.description: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.

fields.name: nolegmarketdisruptionevents
fields.description: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionevent
fields.description: Specifies the market disruption event. For commodities see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values. For foreign exchange, see https://fixtrading.org/packages/market-disruption-event for code list of applicable event types.

fields.name: nolegmarketdisruptionfallbacks
fields.description: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbacktype
fields.description: Specifies the type of disruption fallback. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

fields.name: nolegmarketdisruptionfallbackreferenceprices
fields.description: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackunderliertype

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackunderliersecurityid
fields.description: Specifies the identifier value of the security.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackunderliersecurityidsource
fields.description: Specifies the class or source scheme of the security identifier.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackunderliersecuritydesc
fields.description: Specifies the description of the underlying security.

fields.name: encodedlegmarketdisruptionfallbackunderliersecuritydesclen

fields.name: encodedlegmarketdisruptionfallbackunderliersecuritydesc
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackopenunits
fields.description: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackbasketcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: legmarketdisruptionfallbackbasketdivisor
fields.description: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

fields.name: legexercisedesc
fields.description: A description of the option exercise.

fields.name: encodedlegexercisedesclen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegExerciseDesc(41483) field.

fields.name: encodedlegexercisedesc
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field.

fields.name: legautomaticexerciseindicator
fields.description: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

fields.name: legautomaticexercisethresholdrate
fields.description: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

fields.name: legexerciseconfirmationmethod
fields.description: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

fields.name: legmanualnoticebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legfallbackexerciseindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

fields.name: leglimitrighttoconfirmindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

fields.name: legexercisesplitticketindicator
fields.description: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

fields.name: nolegoptionexercisebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: legoptionexercisebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: legoptionexercisebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

fields.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise dates.

fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise start date offset.

fields.name: legoptionexercisestartdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise start date offset.

fields.name: legoptionexercisestartdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

fields.name: legoptionexercisestartdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

fields.name: legoptionexerciseskip
fields.description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

fields.name: legoptionexercisenominationdeadline
fields.description: The last date (adjusted) for establishing the option exercise terms.

fields.name: legoptionexercisefirstdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first exercise date.

fields.name: legoptionexerciselastdateunadjusted
