fields.description: Number of UnderlyingProvision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlpaymentdate
fields.description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(42101).

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlpaymentdatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlquotesource
fields.description: Identifies the source of quote information.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlquotereferencepage
fields.description: Identifies the reference "page" from the quote source.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluetime
fields.description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluetimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisionoptionexercisefixeddates
fields.description: Number of UnderlyingProvision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisefixeddate
fields.description: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(42114).

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisefixeddatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseearliestdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseearliestdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisefrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise frequency.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisefrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisestartdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisestartdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisestartdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisestartdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisestartdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisestartdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseperiodskip
fields.description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseboundsfirstdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseboundslastdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseearliesttime
fields.description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseearliesttimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciselatesttime
fields.description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciselatesttimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationtime
fields.description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationtimebusinesscenter
fields.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdatebizdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convnetion used to adjust the underlying instrument provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisions
fields.description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiontype
fields.description: Type of provision.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiondateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiondatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiondateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted date of the provision.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiondatetenorperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiondatetenorunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncalculationagent
fields.description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent(42156) or in the underlying provision parties component.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionsinglepartybuyerside
fields.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionsinglepartysellerside
fields.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisestyle
fields.description: The instrument provision's exercise style.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisemultiplenotional
fields.description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseminimumnotional
fields.description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisemaximumnotional
fields.description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionminimumnumber
fields.description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionmaximumnumber
fields.description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexerciseconfirmation
fields.description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlmethod
fields.description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlcurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlcurrency2
fields.description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlquotetype
fields.description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiontext
fields.description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

fields.name: encodedunderlyingprovisiontextlen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingProvisionText(42712) field.

fields.name: encodedunderlyingprovisiontext
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisionpartyids
fields.description: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionpartyid
fields.description: The party identifier for the payment settlement party.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionpartyidsource
fields.description: Identifies the class or source of the UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) value.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionpartyrole
fields.description: Identifies the type or role of UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) specified.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisionpartysubids
fields.description: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionpartysubid
fields.description: Underlying provision party sub-identifier, if applicable for UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174).

fields.name: underlyingprovisionpartysubidtype
fields.description: The type of UnderlyingProvisionPartySubID(42178).

fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlpaymentdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisioncashsettlvaluedatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisionoptionexercisebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexercisebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionexpirationdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionoptionrelevantunderlyingdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nounderlyingprovisiondatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingprovisiondatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: deliverystreamdeliverypointsource
fields.description: Identifies the class or source of DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41062).

fields.description: Description of the delivery point identified in DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41062).

fields.name: legdeliverystreamdeliverypointsource
fields.description: Identifies the class or source of LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41433).

fields.name: legdeliverystreamdeliverypointdesc
fields.description: Description of the delivery point identified in LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41433).

fields.name: underlyingdeliverystreamdeliverypointsource
fields.description: Identifies the class or source of UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41781).

fields.name: underlyingdeliverystreamdeliverypointdesc
fields.description: Description of the delivery point identified in UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41781).

fields.name: nolegcontractualdefinitions
fields.description: Number of financing definitions in the repeating group.

fields.name: legcontractualdefinition
fields.description: Specifies which contract definition, such as those published by ISDA, will apply for the terms of the trade. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-definitions for values.

fields.name: nolegfinancingtermsupplements
fields.description: Number of financing terms supplements in the repeating group.

fields.name: legfinancingtermsupplementdesc
fields.description: Identifies the applicable contractual supplement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-supplement for values.

fields.name: legfinancingtermsupplementdate
fields.description: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the contractual supplement.

fields.name: nolegcontractualmatrices
fields.description: Number of contractual matrices in the repeating group.

fields.name: legcontractualmatrixsource
fields.description: Identifies the applicable contract matrix. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/matrix-type-1-0.xml for values.

fields.name: legcontractualmatrixdate
fields.description: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the contract matrix. If not specified, the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

fields.name: legcontractualmatrixterm
fields.description: Specifies the applicable key into the relevant contract matrix. In the case of 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions, the LegContractualMatrixTerm(42206) is not applicable and is to be omitted. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-matrix-transaction-type for values.

fields.name: cashsettldateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted cash settlement date.

fields.name: cashsettldatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the Instrument component.

fields.name: cashsettldaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: cashsettldateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement date offset.

fields.name: cashsettldateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

fields.name: cashsettldateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

fields.name: cashsettldateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted cash settlement date.

fields.name: nocashsettldatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: cashsettldatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: cashsettlpricesource
fields.description: The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

fields.name: cashsettlpricedefault
fields.description: The default election for determining settlement price.

fields.name: dividendfloatingrateindex
fields.description: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

fields.name: dividendfloatingrateindexcurveperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

fields.name: dividendfloatingrateindexcurveunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

fields.name: dividendfloatingratemultiplier
fields.description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

fields.name: dividendfloatingratespread
fields.description: The basis points spread from the index specified in DividendFloatingRateIndex(42218).

fields.name: dividendfloatingratespreadpositiontype
fields.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

fields.name: dividendfloatingratetreatment
fields.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

fields.name: dividendcaprate
fields.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

fields.name: dividendcapratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: dividendcapratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: dividendfloorrate
fields.description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

fields.name: dividendfloorratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: dividendfloorratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: dividendinitialrate
fields.description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

fields.name: dividendfinalrateroundingdirection
fields.description: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

fields.name: dividendfinalrateprecision
fields.description: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

fields.name: dividendaveragingmethod
fields.description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

fields.name: dividendnegativeratetreatment
fields.description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

fields.name: nodividendaccrualpaymentdatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of entries in the DividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenterGrp.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymentdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymentdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymentdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymentdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymentdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymentdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymeentdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

fields.name: dividendaccrualpaymentdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted accrual payment date.

fields.name: dividendreinvestmentindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

fields.name: dividendentitlementevent
fields.description: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

fields.name: dividendamounttype
fields.description: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

fields.name: dividendunderlierrefid
fields.description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: extraordinarydividendpartyside
fields.description: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

fields.name: extraordinarydividendamounttype
fields.description: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

fields.name: extraordinarydividendcurrency
fields.description: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: extraordinarydividenddeterminationmethod
fields.description: Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

fields.name: dividendaccrualfixedrate
fields.description: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal.

fields.name: dividendcompoundingmethod
fields.description: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

fields.name: dividendnumofindexunits
fields.description: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

fields.name: dividendcashpercentage
fields.description: Declared cash dividend percentage.

fields.name: dividendcashequivalentpercentage
fields.description: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage.

fields.name: noncashdividendtreatment
fields.description: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

fields.name: dividendcomposition
fields.description: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

fields.name: specialdividendsindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

fields.name: materialdividendsindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

fields.name: optionsexchangedividendsindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

fields.name: additionaldividendsindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

fields.name: alldividendsindicator
fields.description: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted FX trigger date.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted FX trigger date.

fields.name: nodividendfxtriggerdatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of entries in the DividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenterGrp.

fields.name: dividendfxtriggerdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nodividendperiods
fields.description: Number of entries in the DividendPeriodGrp component.

fields.description: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

fields.description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

fields.name: dividendperiodenddateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

fields.description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

fields.description: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

fields.description: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

fields.name: noreturnratefxconversions
fields.description: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

fields.name: returnratefxcurrencysymbol
fields.description: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: returnratefxrate
fields.description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in ReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(42732).

fields.name: returnratefxratecalc

fields.name: returnratepricesequence

fields.name: returnratecommissionbasis
fields.description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

fields.description: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: returnratetotalcommissionpertrade
fields.description: The total commission per trade.

fields.name: returnratedeterminationmethod
fields.description: Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

fields.name: returnrateamountrelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

fields.name: returnratequotemeasuretype
fields.description: Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

fields.name: returnratequoteunits
fields.description: Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

fields.name: returnratequotemethod
fields.description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

fields.name: returnratequotecurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

fields.name: returnratequotecurrencytype
fields.description: Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

fields.name: returnratequotetimetype
fields.description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

fields.name: returnratequotetime
fields.description: The time when the quote is to be generated.

fields.description: The date when the quote is to be generated.

fields.name: returnratequoteexpirationtime
fields.description: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

fields.name: returnratequoteexchange
fields.description: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

fields.name: returnratequotepricingmodel
fields.description: Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

fields.name: returnratecashflowtype
fields.description: Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

fields.name: returnratevaluationtimetype
fields.description: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

fields.name: returnratevaluationtime
fields.description: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

fields.name: returnratevaluationtimebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with ReturnRateValuationTimeType(42756) or ReturnRateValuationTime(42757), e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: returnratevaluationpriceoption
fields.description: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

fields.name: returnratefinalpricefallback
fields.description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

fields.name: noreturnrateinformationsources

fields.name: returnrateinformationsource
fields.description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

fields.description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When ReturnRateInformationSource(42762) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

fields.name: returnratereferencepageheading
fields.description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

fields.description: The effective date of the StreamVersion(42784).

fields.description: Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

fields.name: streamnotionaladjustments
fields.description: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

fields.name: nounderlyingcashsettldatebusinesscenters

fields.description: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

fields.description: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndex(42801).

fields.name: underlyingdividendfloatingratespreadpositiontype
fields.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

fields.name: underlyingdividendfloatingratetreatment
fields.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

fields.name: underlyingdividendcaprate
fields.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

fields.name: underlyingdividendcapratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingdividendcapratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingdividendfloorrate
fields.description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

fields.name: underlyingdividendfloorratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingdividendfloorratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

fields.name: underlyingdividendfinalrateroundingdirection
fields.description: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

fields.name: underlyingdividendfinalrateprecision
fields.description: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

fields.name: underlyingdividendaccrualfixedrate

fields.name: underlyingdividendperiodpaymentdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

fields.name: underlyingdividendperiodxid
fields.description: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

fields.name: nounderlyingdividendperiodbusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of entries in UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenterGrp.

fields.name: underlyingdividendperiodbusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nounderlyingextraordinaryevents
fields.description: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingextraordinaryeventtype
fields.description: Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

fields.name: underlyingextraordinaryeventvalue
fields.description: The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

fields.name: underlyingsettlmethodelectingpartyside
fields.description: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

fields.name: underlyingmakewholedate
fields.description: The date through which the option cannot be exercised without penalty.

fields.name: underlyingmakewholeamount
fields.description: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the UnderlyingMakeWholeDate(42888).

fields.name: underlyingmakewholebenchmarkcurvename
fields.description: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingmakewholebenchmarkcurvepoint
fields.description: The point on the floating rate index curve.

fields.name: underlyingmakewholerecallspread
fields.description: Spread over the floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingmakewholebenchmarkquote
fields.description: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

fields.name: underlyingmakewholeinterpolationmethod
fields.description: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcashsettlindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingxidref
fields.description: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingspread
fields.description: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminterpolationmethod
fields.description: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreaminterpolationperiod
fields.description: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfixedrate
fields.description: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdates
fields.description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdate
fields.description: The compounding date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42903).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatesbusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The compounding dates business day convention.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatesrelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatesoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatesoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatesoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingperiodskip
fields.description: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingrollconvention
fields.description: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamboundsfirstdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamboundslastdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatesbusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingdatesbusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingenddateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted compounding end date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingenddaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingenddateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingenddateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingenddateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingenddateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted compounding end date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingrateindex
fields.description: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingrateindexcurveperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingrateindexcurveunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingratemultiplier
fields.description: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingratespread
fields.description: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42923).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingratespreadpositiontype
fields.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingratetreatment
fields.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingcaprate
fields.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingcapratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingcapratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfloorrate
fields.description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfloorratebuyside
fields.description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfloorratesellside
fields.description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundinginitialrate
fields.description: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfinalrateroundingdirection
fields.description: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingfinalrateprecision
fields.description: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingaveragingmethod
fields.description: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingnegativeratetreatment
fields.description: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingstartdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted compounding start date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingstartdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingstartdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingstartdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingstartdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamcompoundingstartdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted compounding start date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamformulaimagelength
fields.description: Length in bytes of the UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImage(42948) field.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamformulaimage
fields.description: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalpricepaymentdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted final price payment date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalpricepaymentdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalpricepaymentdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalpricepaymentdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalpricepaymentdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfinalpricepaymentdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted final price payment date.

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentstreamfixingdates
fields.description: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdate
fields.description: The fixing date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateType(42957).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfixingdatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfirstobservationdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfirstobservationdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfirstobservationdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamfirstobservationdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted initial price observation date.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamunderlierrefid
fields.description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratenotionalreset
fields.description: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkinitiallevel
fields.description: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkclosinglevelindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkexpiringlevelindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkestimatedtradingdays
fields.description: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkstrikeprice
fields.description: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkstrikepricetype
fields.description: For a variance swap specifies how UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42968) is expressed.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkmaximumboundary
fields.description: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinkminimumboundary
fields.description: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamlinknumberofdataseries
fields.description: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamvarianceunadjustedcap
fields.description: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamrealizedvariancemethod
fields.description: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamdaysadjustmentindicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamnearestexchangecontractrefid
fields.description: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamveganotionalamount
fields.description: Vega Notional represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamformulacurrency
fields.description: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamformulacurrencydeterminationmethod
fields.description: Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamformulareferenceamount
fields.description: Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of reference amounts.

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentstreamformulas
fields.description: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamformula
fields.description: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstreamformuladesc
fields.description: A description of the math formula in UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormula(42982).

fields.description: The unadjusted stub start date.

fields.description: The stub start date business day convention.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubstartdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the stub start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubstartdateoffsetunit

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubstartdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative stub start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubstartdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted stub start date.

fields.name: nounderlyingpaymentstubstartdatebusinesscenters
fields.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingpaymentstubstartdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub start date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionbreakfeeelection
fields.description: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

fields.name: underlyingprovisionbreakfeerate
fields.description: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

fields.name: underlyingratespreadinitialvalue
fields.description: Specifies the initial rate spread for a basket underlier.

fields.name: nounderlyingratespreadsteps
fields.description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingratespreadstepdate
fields.description: The date that the rate spread step takes affect.

fields.name: underlyingratespreadstepvalue
fields.description: The the value of the new rate spread as of the UnderlyingRateSpreadStepDate(43006).

fields.name: nounderlyingreturnratedates
fields.description: Number of iterations in the return rate date repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratedatemode
fields.description: Specifies the valuation type applicable to the return rate date.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationstartdateunadjusted
fields.description: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationstartdaterelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationstartdateoffsetperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationstartdateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationstartdateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationstartdateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

fields.description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationenddateoffsetunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationenddateoffsetdaytype
fields.description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationenddateadjusted
fields.description: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationfrequencyperiod
fields.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationfrequencyunit
fields.description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationfrequencyrollconvention
fields.description: The convention for determining the sequence of return rate valuation dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdatebusinessdayconvention
fields.description: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

fields.name: nounderlyingreturnratefxconversions
fields.description: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratefxcurrencysymbol
fields.description: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratefxrate
fields.description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in UnderlyingReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(43031).

fields.name: underlyingreturnratefxratecalc
fields.description: Specifies whether UnderlyingReturnRateFXRate(43032) should be multiplied or divided.

fields.name: nounderlyingreturnrates
fields.description: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratepricesequence
fields.description: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratecommissionbasis
fields.description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratecommissionamount
fields.description: The commission amount.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratecommissioncurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratetotalcommissionpertrade
fields.description: The total commission per trade.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratedeterminationmethod
fields.description: Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnrateamountrelativeto
fields.description: Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotemeasuretype
fields.description: Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequoteunits
fields.description: Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotemethod
fields.description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotecurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotecurrencytype
fields.description: Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotetimetype
fields.description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotetime
fields.description: The time when the quote is to be generated.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotedate
fields.description: The date when the quote is to be generated.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequoteexpirationtime
fields.description: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTimeType(43047) or UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTime(43048) and UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteDate(43049), e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequoteexchange
fields.description: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratequotepricingmodel
fields.description: Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratecashflowtype
fields.description: Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationtimetype
fields.description: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationtime
fields.description: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationtimebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTimeType(43055) or UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTime(43056) , e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationpriceoption
fields.description: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratefinalpricefallback
fields.description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

fields.name: nounderlyingreturnrateinformationsources

fields.name: underlyingreturnrateinformationsource
fields.description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratereferencepage
fields.description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When UnderlyingReturnRateInformationSource(43061) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

fields.name: underlyingreturnratereferencepageheading
fields.description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

fields.name: nounderlyingreturnrateprices
fields.description: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratepricebasis
fields.description: The basis of the return price.

fields.name: underlyingreturnrateprice
fields.description: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratepricecurrency
fields.description: Specifies the currency of the price of the underlying swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratepricetype
fields.description: Specifies whether the UnderlyingReturnRatePrice(43066) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

fields.name: nounderlyingreturnratevaluationdatebusinesscenters

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdatebusinesscenter
fields.description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

fields.name: nounderlyingreturnratevaluationdates
fields.description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdate
fields.description: The return rate valuation date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateType(43073).

fields.name: underlyingreturnratevaluationdatetype
fields.description: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

fields.name: nounderlyingsettlmethodelectiondatebusinesscenters
